new_roles.title: Director of Quality Assurance
new_roles.description:
As the Regional Director of Food Safety & Quality Assurance, you will be responsible for overseeing and ensuring the highest standards of food safety and quality across our operations in the United States and/or Canada. You will lead a team of professionals dedicated to maintaining compliance with regulatory requirements and company policies while driving continuous improvement initiatives. This role requires strong leadership, strategic thinking, and the ability to collaborate effectively across departments and locations.

**Duties and Responsibilities****:**

* Ensure individual plant teams are executing expected actions to meet corporate objectives
* Manages assigned plant FS-Q managers, and interacts with operations, R&D, and other relevant teams to implement the company’s strategic plan that encompasses all aspects of food safety and quality.
* Coaches plant FS-Q managers to ensure they perform according with strategic and the tactical/milestones necessary to achieve operational goals.
* Manages key customer (other than McDonald’s) QA relationships in conjunction with sales personnel.
* Work in partnership with direct manager to be in compliance with the regional McDonald’s FSQA expectations.
* Support and coach Plant FS-Q Managers for administering the department’s budget to ensure proper allocation of resources
* Assess and manages plant resources to ensure the QA and Food Safety KPI goals are achieved for the manufacturing plants under its purview.
* Ensures the food safety and quality of product and services by assessing compliance with product testing, performing internal assessments and audits of the FS-Q system and product lines, placing defective products on hold and taking corrective action
* Insures that all regulatory requirements are met including weights/measures, food safety, product claims, declarations, etc.
* Collaborates to standardize when required, QA policies/procedures to improve efficiency and reduce cost.
* Identifies and communicates FS- QA technologies to improve quality and reduce costs.
* Coaches and develops QA Managers to perform at a constantly exceptional level of performance, including but not limited to the sanitation program, compliance with the GFSI approved scheme audits; and when required acts as the plant’s SQF back-up Practitioner.
* Performs all other duties as assigned.

**Minimum Job Requirements:**

**Education/Certifications** **and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Food Science, Microbiology, Chemistry, or related field (Master’s degree preferred).
* Minimum of five (5) years of management experience including Quality Management Systems and/or Manufacturing experience.
* Prefer experience in a bakery/dry mixing (dry blending, frozen dough and baked goods) production environment.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:**

* Proficient use of computer, Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OneNote), and other related applications or software.
* Demonstrated leadership experience and a sense of urgency and the drive to make continuous improvements
* Ability to operate at single and multi-site levels from management to “hands on” to accomplish tasks. Must be a “working manager.”
* Demonstrated ability to make and act on decisions while balancing speed, food safety, quality and risk.
* Strong background in sanitation principles and practices, GFSI approved schemes (SQF, BRC), HACCP, GMPs, Safety and SPC.
* Ability to think clearly and in a decisive manner while remaining calm under in pressure situations.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills.
* Ability to work in a matrix environment and build strong relationships by being transparent, reliable, and accountable. Strong interpersonal skills backed-up by strong technical knowledge are critical to success in this role.
* Must have good writing skills and be able to communicate effectively with people at all levels of the company.

**Supervisory Responsibilities****:**

* Manage multiple direct reports including but not limited to: Sr. Quality Assurance Manager, Quality Assurance Manager, Analyst.
* Work requires supervising and monitoring work performance of direct reports including making final decisions on hiring and disciplinary actions, evaluating program/work objectives and effectiveness, and realigning work and staffing assignments, as needed.
* Develop functional responsibilities of individuals that report to this position and ensure that best-in class output is created.

**Working Conditions and Physical Effort:**

* Typical work in office environment but will spend periods of time in manufacturing plants which will have exposure to unusual elements, such as dirt, dust, fumes, odors, darkness and/or poor lighting, noise and vibration. Seasonal exposure to weather elements to include, but not limited to, extreme temperatures, wetness and humidity.
* Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at times.
* Substantial travel required (up to 50%) mostly in the North America.

**Expectations:**

* Will demonstrate, promote, and exemplify the Company’s Core Values.

At C.H. Guenther, we value transparency in compensation. By providing the salary range for this role, we aim to promote fairness and help candidates make informed choices about their career. The salary range for this role is:

$142,500.00 - $228,000.00 USD

Actual compensation may vary based on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience, as well as geographic location.

**C.H. Guenther & Son will never offer or pay a wage or salary that is not compliant with applicable local, state, or federal pay laws, including minimum salary thresholds.**

We also offer a variety of benefits, including health and disability insurance, retirement savings options, flexible spending accounts, employee assistance programs, educational assistance, parental leave, paid time off, and company-paid holidays.

For additional information about our company, go to www.chg.com.

C.H. Guenther & Son and its subsidiaries are E-Verify participating employers.

Click here for more information regarding E-verify.

All offers of employment are contingent upon successful completion of the pre-employment screening process which includes a drug screen and review of criminal background and other records as required.

new_roles.title: Quality Director
new_roles.description:
We are a fast-paced business with ambitious growth plans; so if you are dedicated, enthusiastic and always seeking ways to improve, you'll enjoy a career with us!

Director of Quality

**Weston - Florida, USA | Permanent | Full-time**

 

**About Ontic Weston**
----------------------

Weston is Ontic's newest site and an important part of the next stage of our growth in the US.

Acquired in 2026, the 130,000 sq ft facility will become a dedicated Original Equipment production site, complementing our MRO Center of Excellence in nearby Miramar. Together, our two South Florida locations give Ontic the space and capability to continue expanding as customer demand grows.

Joining Weston at this stage means more than joining a new facility. You'll have the opportunity to help build it - shaping teams, ways of working and culture as we prepare the site for operations in 2027. If you're energised by growth, change and the chance to create something from the ground up, this is a rare opportunity to do exactly that.

 

**The opportunity**
-------------------

Lead Quality for an aerospace manufacturing operation where reliability and customer confidence are fundamental. At Weston, you'll shape the way quality is built into products and processes while supporting a growing site's operational priorities.

You'll lead Quality Engineering, Quality Control and inspection activities, working with operations and external stakeholders to strengthen compliance, resolve complex issues and drive lasting improvements in product and process quality.

**What you'll be doing**
------------------------

* Lead and develop Quality Engineering, Quality Control and inspection teams, setting clear expectations and priorities.

* Develop, install and then maintain effective quality management systems and applicable aerospace certification requirements.

* Represent Quality with customers and government quality representatives, resolving issues constructively.

* Oversee quality planning, contract reviews, audits, material review activity and corrective actions.

* Partner across functions on new products, product integration and transitions into production.

* Use quality measures and root-cause analysis to reduce defects, scrap, warranty costs and repeat issues.

* Build a culture of prevention, accountability and continuous improvement.

 

**What you'll bring**
---------------------

* At least 10 years of aerospace Quality experience in an AS9100 manufacturing environment, including significant leadership responsibility.

* A bachelor's degree in Engineering or a relevant discipline, plus knowledge of AS9100 internal auditing.

* Experience leading Quality Engineering, Quality Control and inspection teams in high-mix aerospace manufacturing.

* Knowledge of AS9100, ISO 9001, Federal Aviation Administration and Department of Defense requirements, and applicable contract clauses.

* Experience with audits, customer approvals, contract reviews, material review and corrective action.

* Strong structured problem-solving and executive stakeholder communication skills.

* Lean or Six Sigma experience and FAA designated manufacturing inspection representative training or certification would be advantageous.

 

**Why Ontic?**
--------------

At Ontic, we're specialists in keeping critical aircraft flying. Our work supports civil and military aviation around the world, giving established aircraft products the long-term support they need to remain safe, reliable and available.

But it's our people who make that possible. We're a growing, global team where you're trusted to take ownership, encouraged to challenge how things have always been done and supported to develop your career as our business grows.

We believe in embracing the challenge - working together to solve complex problems and create opportunities for our customers, our business and each other.

 

**Benefits at Ontic**
---------------------

At Ontic, we're committed to supporting our people to thrive - at work and beyond. Our benefits are designed to support your wellbeing, development and financial security, while giving everyone the opportunity to share in our success.

* Goal Share bonus program - everyone at Ontic is automatically enrolled, giving us all the opportunity to share in our success

* Paid volunteering time - giving you time to support a cause or community that matters to you

* 24/7 wellbeing support - confidential support available through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

* Employee discounts - access to discounts and offers across a range of retailers and services

* Learning and development - opportunities to build your skills, develop your career and grow with Ontic

* Employee referral program - rewarding you for introducing great people to Team Ontic

* Comprehensive medical insurance

* Competitive PTO, holiday pay and sick leave

* 401(k) plan - with up to 4% company match

* 9/80 work schedule - where applicable

 

**Ready to embrace the challenge?**
-----------------------------------

If this sounds like the kind of opportunity where you could make an impact, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today and see where a career with Team Ontic could take you.

**Compensation Pay Range**

*Ontic Engineering and Manufacturing Inc. is an Equal* *Opportunity* *employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex including sexual orientation and gender identity, national origin, disability, protected Veteran* 
*Status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.*

*This position must meet export control compliance requirements. To meet export control compliance requirements, a “U.S. Person ” as defined by 22. C.F.R. §120.15 is required. “U.S. Person” includes U.S. Citizen, lawful permanent resident, asylee, or refugee.*

new_roles.description:
**Job Description:**
--------------------

**Job Title** Quality Assurance, Operations Support Services & Service Delivery

**Corporate Title** Director

**Location** Santa Ana, CA

**Overview**

*As a Director within Document Custody Operations, you will lead quality assurance, operations support services, and service delivery to strengthen execution, protect client and organizational interests, and improve service outcomes. You will oversee quality control, training, operational risk and controls, continuous improvement, and sustained regulatory, agency, investor, and audit readiness. As a senior operational representative and Document Custody and agency subject matter expert, you will translate agency, investor, client, contractual, and internal requirements into practical operating standards. You will partner across Operations, Client Services, control functions, Technology, and delivery partners to resolve complex issues and balance client service, efficiency, and custodial obligations.*

**What We Offer You**

* A diverse and inclusive environment that embraces change, innovation, and collaboration
* A hybrid working model, allowing for in-office / work from home flexibility, generous vacation, personal and volunteer days
* Employee Resource Groups support an inclusive workplace for everyone and promote community engagement
* Competitive compensation packages including health and wellbeing benefits, retirement savings plans, parental leave, and family building benefits
Educational resources, matching gift and volunteer programs 

**What You’ll Do**

* Own the Document Custody quality assurance framework, operating standards, governance, and controls, including maker/checker reviews, segregation of duties, approvals, system validations, and evidence requirements
* Oversee independent, risk-based quality control testing, sampling, defect tracking, root-cause analysis, corrective and preventative action, and remediation validation; report quality performance and emerging risks to senior leadership
* Lead training and knowledge-management governance, including agency and document fundamentals, competency assessments, certification standards, cross-training, and targeted retraining informed by quality findings and audit observations
* Translate Federal National Mortgage Association (FNMA), Federal Home Loan Mortgage Corporation (FHLMC), Government National Mortgage Association (GNMA), private investor, client, and custodial requirements into procedures and service expectations; guide collateral documentation, certification, endorsements, assignments, allonges, trailing documents, releases, reinstatements, exceptions, and inventory controls
* Lead operational support and client service delivery, including implementations, service levels, capacity planning, complex research, incidents, aging items, and escalations; balance responsiveness with contractual commitments, controls, cost, and risk appetite
Maintain audit and examination readiness, oversee findings and management action plans, and partner with Technology on workflow, automation, data, and reporting enhancements that deliver measurable improvements in quality, capacity, client outcomes, and resilience 

**How You’ll Lead**

* Lead and develop direct reports and matrixed teams across quality assurance, quality control, training, audit support, operational support, service delivery, and process improvement, establishing clear decision rights, accountability, and development objectives
* Partner with Operations, Client Services, and clients as a senior advisor and escalation point, ensuring service commitments are executable, controlled, and aligned with custodial obligations
Influence senior leadership, Audit, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Technology, vendors, and offshore partners to challenge risk decisions constructively, resolve cross-functional issues, and deliver sustainable remediation and transformation 

**Skills You’ll Need**

* Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Risk Management, Operations Management, Mortgage Banking, or a related discipline; equivalent directly relevant experience may be considered where permitted by organizational policy
* Extensive experience in document custody, mortgage banking, loan servicing, securities services, collateral management, quality assurance, operational risk, service delivery, or another highly controlled financial-services environment
* Demonstrated experience with Quality Assurance/Quality Control frameworks, control testing, issue management, root-cause analysis, corrective and preventative action, training governance, operational reporting, and client escalation management, including support for audits, client examinations, agency reviews, regulatory assessments, or formal control testing
* Knowledge of operational risk, controls, quality management, audit readiness, remediation, and service-delivery governance, with the ability to translate agency, investor, client, contractual, and internal requirements into operational standards
* Working proficiency with Microsoft 365 and experience using dashboards, workflow tools, quality trackers, case-management systems, or operational reporting platforms
Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimize workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs 

**Skills That Will Help You Excel**

* Direct working knowledge of Document Custody and FNMA, FHLMC, GNMA, private investor, collateral, certification, release, and exception requirements
* Experience leading managers, professionals, programs, or complex cross-functional operating models, with the ability to influence across functions, locations, vendors, and onshore/offshore teams
* Executive presence and effective written and verbal communication with clients, auditors, senior management, control functions, and technical subject matter experts
* Analytical judgment to identify patterns, quantify operational impacts, challenge assumptions, and make risk-informed decisions
Disciplined prioritization and follow-through when managing multiple critical issues, with timely escalation of material concerns 

**Expectations**

It is the Bank’s expectation that employees hired into this role will work in the Santa Ana office in accordance with the Bank’s hybrid working model.

Deutsche Bank provides reasonable accommodations to candidates and employees with a substantiated need based on disability and/or religion.

The salary range for this position in California is $133,000 to $203,500. Actual salaries may be based on a number of factors including, but not limited to, a candidate’s skill set, experience, education, work location and other qualifications. Posted salary ranges do not include incentive compensation or any other type of remuneration.

**Deutsche Bank Benefits**

At Deutsche Bank, we recognize that our benefit programs have a profound impact on our colleagues. That’s why we are focused on providing benefits and perks that enable our colleagues to live authentically and be their whole selves, at every stage of life. We provide access to physical, emotional, and financial wellness benefits that allow our colleagues to stay financially secure and strike balance between work and home. Click here to learn more!

Learn more about your life at Deutsche Bank through the eyes of our current employees: https://careers.db.com/life

The California Consumer Privacy Act outlines how companies can use personal information. If you are interested in receiving a copy of Deutsche Bank’s California Privacy Notice please email HR.Direct@DB.com .

**#LI-HYBRID**

We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.

Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.

We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. Click these links to view Deutsche Bank’s Equal Opportunity Policy Statement and the following notices: EEOC Know Your Rights ; Employee Rights and Responsibilities under the Family and Medical Leave Act ; and Employee Polygraph Protection Act .

new_roles.description:
**Job Title:** Global Director, Supplier Quality

**Job Location:** Southfield, MI

**What we offer:**

VeoneerSafety Systemsis the world leader in Automotive Electronic Safety Systems. Veoneer’s scalable, best-in-class restraint control systems are mitigating the effects of a car crash. To date, we have delivered more than 1 billion devices to car manufacturers globally.
 
 
Veoneer Safety Systems has an international and collaborative team of 2,700 employees in 11 countries. We empower our people and are dedicated to their professional development and growth*.* 
 
Veoneer Safety Systems – Protect Everyone in Every Crash.

**What you'll do:**

The Global Director of Supplier Quality leads the global SQ organization, setting strategy, standards, and accountability for supplier readiness, performance, and continuous improvement.

The role combines global Supplier Quality leadership (80%) with North America Engineering Quality and Operational Quality leadership (20%).

**Key Responsibilities for Supplier Quality** (80% of role)

**Strategic Leadership & Global Deployment**

* Set global SQ strategy aligned with corporate, customer, sourcing, and manufacturing objectives.
* Define and execution of Supplier Quality Policies, Standards, Processes, Methods and Systems.
* Owner of Veoneer Supplier Manual (VSM), Supplier Quality Project (SQP) – APQP & PPAP, Supplier Non-Conformance Material (NCM) Management.
* Align cross-functional priorities, resources, and accountability; establish SQE oversight of workload, open issues, owners, overdue actions, and escalations.
* Monitor supplier quality targets, initiatives and indicators to ensure compliance to Veoneer Supplier Quality related policies, standards and reporting.

**Supplier Development & Standards Compliance**

* Oversee new supplier assessment, qualification, and development with Purchasing and Engineering; improve assessment models and ensure teams close risks and capability gaps before sourcing and production approval.
* Set common supplier requirements, risk-based audit and development expectations, and change controls; ensure existing suppliers improve capability and sustain company and customer compliance.
* Representing quality in Supplier Sourcing Board.

**Supplier Performance & Major Quality Issues**

* Lead major supplier escalations with supplier executives and cross-functional teams, ensuring containment, exposure assessment, production and customer protection, and verified permanent corrective actions.
* Drive common KPIs and improvement targets for supplier PPM, repeat defects, corrective-action aging, disruptions.
* Require leadership reviews and improvement plans for systemic issues, sharing lessons learned across suppliers.
* Supplier Scorecard (VS051 rating) and drive continuous improvement for supplier quality performance.

**Supplier APQP / PPAP & Safe Launch**

* Ensure on time and effective supplier APQP, PPAP, and Safe Launch for new programs, suppliers, and changes, including risk reviews, capability verification, and readiness-gap closure before production release.

**Quality Tools, Talent Development & Training**

* Set expectations for consistent SQE application of core quality tools, process audits, and structured problem solving to strengthen prevention and corrective-action effectiveness.
* Assess global SQ team capabilities and set development priorities with regional managers to strengthen technical expertise, expand skills, and build future leaders through training, mentoring, and succession planning.
* Supplier Quality talent review and succession plan.

**Regional Leadership: Engineering Quality & Operational Quality** (20% of role)

* Represent Quality Leadership team in regional activities across RDE, Manufacturing and Supplier Quality teams.
* Align regional priorities, governance, performance reviews, and escalations with global Engineering Quality and Operational Quality leaders and standards.
* Guide development and launch readiness, quality system execution, major issue resolution, and lessons learned while retaining local execution accountability.

**What you'll bring:**

**Education:** Bachelor’s degree in engineering.

**Experience:** Minimum 15 years in supplier quality, including supplier qualification, development, major issue resolution, and talent development. Electronics experience required; automotive SQ experience strongly preferred. Experience leading a multinational organization is preferred.

**Skills:**

* Global SQ leadership and effective matrix-team management.
* Cross-functional influence, supplier executive engagement, and timely decision-making.
* Strong supplier APQP, PPAP, change management, and Safe Launch knowledge.
* Advanced PFMEA, control plan, MSA, SPC, capability, audit, and 8D expertise; proven data-driven problem resolution and daily management.
* Strong commodity expertise for IC, PCB and/or mechanical parts is preferred.
* Ability to work effectively across cultures and time zones.
* Experience in other Quality domains is preferred

**Location:** Physical location Markham, Ontario, Canada or Southfield, Michigan; global scope across North America, Europe, India, and Asia.

**Travel:** International travel will be required 8-10 times per year.

**Reporting / Collaboration:**

* Reports to SVP Manufacturing & Quality.
* Solid-line responsibility for tech-center SQEs; dotted-line functional leadership of plant SQEs, with plant leadership retaining local operational accountability.
* Partners with Purchasing, Operations, Engineering, Industrialization, Program Management, and supplier leadership.

new_roles.title: Director of Quality
new_roles.description:
Responsible to manage, promote, and continuously maintain a compliant quality management system by effectively managing the quality department that consist of validation, quality inspection, document control, change control, customer complaints, metrology, CAPA management, nonconforming product, calibration, receiving inspection and product release activities. As a quality manager you will ensure that the manufacturing site meets and applies the Global Quality Policies and Guidelines relating to, ISO 9001 & 13485 standards, FDA 21 CFR 820 regulations, customer requirements and comply with necessary local and international regulations.

**Essential Job Functions and Responsibilities****:**

* Responsible for , leading developing, implementing and manage an effective quality management systems that supports the company-wide quality policy, ISO 9000, ISO 13485 and FDA 21 CFR 820 regulations for medical devices with a continuous improvement programs.
* Lead, develop, implement and maintain quality systems for controlling product quality using process capability, inspection, auditing and statistical analysis.
* Lead, develop, implement and maintain an effective quality system for preventing nonconforming product and/or its recurrence using quality planning, material review, corrective action and quality reporting.
* Responsible for selection, interviewing and onboarding of new hires and develop a relevant training program and plan for all site personnel.
* Responsible for leading, driving and enforcing quality programs in collaboration with manufacturing team.
* Resolve customer concerns, complaints and provide feedback on quality issues.
* Analyze daily and monthly quality reports and develop tests to improve product quality.
* Manage day to day department activities.
* Support company quality policy and objectives.
* Ensure products produced meets customer expectations (approve quality specifications) and regulatory requirements
* Lead customer audits, ISO audits and Internal audits
* Achieve financial objectives (maintain department salaries within budget, prepare the Quality budget, schedule the expenditures)
* Follow and report of the site quality performances from a quality standpoint and ensure alignment with Business Unit and manage continuous improvement for product quality
* In cooperation with the Sites Quality Coordinator, develop and implement Quality Objectives in line with objectives of the business unit
* Lead and influence a quality mindset to quality and operations to maintain, improving and maintaining quality system requirements.
* Continually improve quality through analyzing, identifying, and eliminating root causes. Such improvements include reducing defects, decreasing scrap, reducing waste, and improving outputs.
* Apply and evaluate testing and inspection methods; including the identification of requirements for improvements.
* Develop and implement quality cost reduction concepts and techniques.
* Manage department resources, including work assignments, training, cross training, personnel issues, hiring decisions, performance appraisals, motivation, efficiency, capacity and accuracy of work.
* Ensure shift-to-shift communication.
* Provide a safe work environment and resolve any safety issues that arise.
* Perform other job-related duties as assigned.

**Core Competencies:**

* Facilitation
* Conflict Management
* Fostering Learning
* Information Gathering & Processing
* Interactive Communication
* Partnering
* Relationship Building
* Research
* Teamwork
* Writing Skills
* Attention to detail
* Adaptability
* Concern for Safety
* Proactive and self-motivated
* Strong time management with priority setting skills
* Client focused

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* Expert knowledge and interpretation of ISO 13485, ISO 9000 standards, 21 CFR 820 and cGMP compliance.
* Ability to lead, implement quality management systems as applicable to ISO and 21 CFR regulations.
* Demonstrate understanding of industry standard validation tools and techniques.
* Demonstrated ability of metrology and basic inspection tools, metrology and injection molding workmanship standards.
* Ability to develop/conduct quality related training programs.
* Effectively communicate in both verbal and written.
* Good organizational skills.
* Excellent English communication skills (both written and verbal).
* Fluency in Spanish a plus.
* Understanding and use of metrology equipment.
* Ability to read drawings and good understanding of geometric tolerancing.
* Knowledge of processing engineering polymers is a plus.
* Exceptional leadership skills which include ability to prioritize, lead, direct, train, and motivate staff.
* Ability to influence peers.
* Excellent planning and organizational skills.
* Good analytical, problem-solving and math skills. Six Sigma and Lean knowledge a plus.
* Understanding and use of sampling plans, Gauge R&R, statistical techniques and SPC.
* Ability to use personal computer and Windows-based software (Outlook, Word and Excel preferred). Use of PC-DMIS metrology software, IQMS manufacturing software and Minitab a plus.

**Education and/or Experience**:

* Bachelor’s degree desirable, four-year college degree (preferably in a sciences chemical, pharmacy, plastics or engineering field) or equivalent combined college/work experience.
* At least 5 years of leading and implementing quality systems in a pharmaceutical or medical device environment
* Manufacturing experience in injection molding plastics industry (or equivalent industry) is a plus.

new_roles.title: Director, Quality Engineering
new_roles.description:
HHAeXchange is the leading technology platform for home and community-based care. Founded in 2008, HHAeXchange was born out of an idea to create a fully comprehensive end-to-end homecare solution to help people who are aging or have disabilities thrive in their homes and communities. Our employees are passionate about transforming the healthcare space by building the only homecare ecosystem that fully connects patients, personal care providers, managed care organizations, and states.

The Director, Quality Engineering will lead the enterprise-wide quality strategy and Quality Assurance (QA) program across HHAeXchange. This role is responsible for standardizing testing processes and tools, driving test automation, and ensuring our products meet high standards for reliability, performance, security, and accessibility. The Director, Quality Engineering will oversee functional and non-functional testing practices, including accessibility (WCAG) and security-related validation, and will own processes that support customer User Acceptance Testing (UAT).

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential job duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**This is a fully remote opportunity for candidates located in the EST or CST time zones within the US only.**

### **Essential Job Duties**

* **Enterprise Quality Leadership:** Develop, implement, and lead the overall quality strategy and QA operating model across the organization.
* **Standardize Testing Processes:** Define and enforce consistent testing approaches including test planning, test cases, regression strategy, and release readiness criteria.
* **Tooling Ownership:** Select, implement, and manage enterprise testing tools for test management, automation, performance, accessibility, and security validation.
* **Automation Strategy:** Drive increased automated test coverage across UI, API, mobile, and services, reducing reliance on manual regression testing.
* **Compliance, Accessibility & VPAT Reporting:**
 + Lead accessibility testing programs aligned to WCAG 2.1+
 + Oversee creation and maintenance of Voluntary Product Accessibility Templates (VPATs) and Accessibility Conformance Reports
 + Partner with Product, Legal, and Compliance to respond to customer accessibility requirements and audits
* **Security & Compliance Testing Support:** Coordinate with Security teams on SAST/DAST, vulnerability validation, and remediation tracking.
* **Customer UAT Support:**
 + Define and support customer UAT strategies and environments
 + Provide test plans, data guidance, and defect triage support during customer acceptance testing cycles
 + Ensure feedback from UAT informs release decisions and product quality improvements
* **Quality Metrics & Reporting:** Establish KPIs to measure product quality, defect escape rate, automation coverage, UAT outcomes, and release readiness; communicate results to leadership.
* **Shift-Left Quality Practices:** Embed quality earlier in the development lifecycle through collaboration on requirements, acceptance criteria, and CI/CD integration.
* **Incident & Defect Management:** Oversee defect triage for high-priority production and pre-production issues and ensure timely resolution and root-cause prevention.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Work closely with Product Management, Engineering, DevOps, Security, and Compliance to ensure alignment of quality practices across releases.
* **Organizational Leadership**: Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing team of QA engineers, SDETs, automation engineers, and accessibility/compliance testers.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Identify quality gaps and drive process improvements that improve product reliability, reduce rework, and increase delivery confidence.
* **Release Governance:** Participate in release readiness reviews and serve as a key stakeholder in go/no-go decisions.
* **Coding agent advocacy:** **Help onboard team members to AI development tools. Share techniques, prompt patterns, and review practices that make AI-augmented development effective and safe in a regulated environment.**

### **Other Job Duties**

* Other duties as assigned by supervisor or HHAeXchange leader.

### **Travel Requirements**

* Travel up to 10%, including overnight travel

### **Required Education, Experience, Certifications and Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field required.
* 10+ years of experience in software engineering within a software product company, with a focus on developing scalable, high-performance systems.
* 4+ years leading QA organizations or enterprise quality programs.
* Proven experience designing and implementing standardized QA processes and test automation strategies in SaaS environments.
* Hands-on experience implementing automated testing frameworks integrated into CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with accessibility testing and standards such as WCAG 2.1+ and authoring VPATs/ACRs.
* Experience supporting security testing practices such as vulnerability scanning, SAST/DAST, and penetration test remediation validation.
* Experience supporting or running customer UAT processes.
* Strong understanding of quality metrics (defect rates, coverage, MTTR, escape rate, etc.) and how to operationalize them.
* Background working in cloud-based architectures and microservices environments.
* Demonstrated success collaborating across engineering, product, and security teams in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong leadership skills with experience managing and developing QA and automation teams.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex topics to technical and non-technical partners.
* **AI/ML fundamentals:** Familiarity with LLM APIs, prompt engineering, and how generative AI can be applied in a product context. Direct project experience preferred.

The base salary range for this US-based, full-time, and exempt position is $175,000-195,000/yr, not including variable compensation. An employee’s exact starting salary will be based on various factors including but not limited to experience, education, training, merit, location, and the ability to exemplify the HHAeXchange core values.

This is a benefits-eligible position. HHAeXchange offers competitive health plans, paid time-off, company paid holidays, 401K retirement program with a Company elected match, including other company sponsored programs.

HHAeXchange is an equal-opportunity employer. The Company offers employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, marital status, veteran status, citizenship, genetic information, hairstyles, or any other status protected by local or federal law.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

new_roles.title: DIRECTOR OF QUALITY & COMPLIANCE
new_roles.description:
**Director of Quality & Compliance**
====================================

**Southern Peaks, Canon City CO**

[Full-Time)

$95,000 To $120,000 Annually

DailyPay Available

**Looking for More Than Just a Job?**
-------------------------------------

At Abraxaswe believe every person deserves the opportunity to live a meaningful, fulfilling, and independent life.

We’re seeking compassionate, dedicated professionals who are looking for more than a paycheck. We’re looking for individuals who want to make a difference, build rewarding careers, and become part of a team committed to helping others succeed.

Whether you’re beginning your career, changing professions, or bringing years of experience, we provide the training, support, and opportunities needed to help you thrive.

**About Abraxas**
-----------------

For more than 50 years, Abraxas has been dedicated to improving lives through high-quality services and support.

Our employees play a vital role in helping individuals achieve greater independence, confidence, and success while promoting dignity, respect, inclusion, and personal choice.

Every day, our team members make a meaningful impact by supporting people in reaching their goals and living their best lives.

**Why Join Our Team?**
======================

**Competitive Pay & Benefits**
------------------------------

* Competitive Compensation
* DailyPay – Access Your Earned Wages Before Payday
* Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance- AFTER 30 DAYS
* 401(k) Retirement Plan
* Paid Time Off
* Employee Assistance Program
* Wellness Programs
* Employee Referral Bonuses
* Company-Paid Training

**Career Growth & Development**
-------------------------------

* Paid Training Programs
* Professional Development Opportunities
* Certification Opportunities
* Leadership Development Programs
* Career Advancement Opportunities
* Opportunities Across Multiple Service Lines

**Meaningful Work That Matters**
--------------------------------

* Make a Difference Every Day
* Support Individuals and Families
* Build Meaningful Relationships
* Strengthen Communities
* Join a Mission-Driven Organization

**What You’ll Do**
==================

As the Director of Quality & Compliance, you will:

Oversees compliance with applicable Colorado Department of Human Services (CDHS) Volume 7 residential licensing rules, including 12 CCR 2509-8, Section 7.714, as well as payer contracts and Joint Commission standards.

* Reviews and approves corrective action plans for regulatory, payer, and accreditation findings before routing them for final approval. Verifies implementation and sustained compliance.
* Works with Quality and Compliance Specialist and Program Directors to prepare for licensing inspections, Medicaid and managed care reviews, and accreditation surveys.
* Serves as a compliance liaison with CDHS and applicable Regional Accountable Entities (RAEs) and other payers. Reviews provider manuals and contract changes and translates requirements into program procedures.
* Conducts program and follow-up audits, including reviews of admissions, assessments, treatment plans, service documentation, discharge planning, and continuity of care.
* Provides technical assistance to Quality and Compliance Specialists and trains program staff on licensing, payer, and accreditation requirements.
* Develops monitoring tools with Quality and Compliance Specialists to verify compliance and consistent implementation of program policies.
* Analyzes audit findings, incidents, grievances, clinical outcomes, and authorization or denial trends. Reports findings and tracks improvement actions with program leaders.
* Partners with Clinical, Admissions, and Billing to oversee utilization management, including prior authorization, concurrent and continued-stay review, medical necessity and level-of-care documentation, and responses to denials and appeals.
* Develops and reviews policies and procedures, supports the annual review process, and verifies that programs maintain current policy and procedure manuals.
* Participates on various internal and external committees as needed.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

**Who We’re Looking For**
=========================

You may be a great fit if you are:

✔ Compassionate

✔ Dependable

✔ Patient

✔ Team-Oriented

✔ Service-Focused

✔ Professional

✔ Positive

✔ Committed to Helping Others

**Qualifications**
==================

Master's degree in social sciences, healthcare or related field and five years of quality and compliance experience or bachelor’s degree in social sciences, healthcare or related field and seven years quality and compliance experience

* Ability to effectively supervise employees.
* Extensive hands-on experience with Colorado Volume 7 residential licensing requirements, Health First Colorado behavioral health managed care, and applicable accreditation standards is critical.
* Ability to interpret and teach the application of regulations, payer requirements, accreditation standards, and contractual language.
* Experience with behavioral health utilization management, including authorization, medical necessity and continued-stay documentation, and payer audits. Experience in youth residential mental health or psychiatric residential treatment facilities (PRTFs) is preferred.
* Experience with Prison Rape Elimination Act (PREA) compliance, including staff training, audit preparation, and corrective action follow-up, is preferred.
* Knowledge of adolescent residential mental health treatment, including trauma-informed care, co-occurring conditions, and the needs of youth involved in child welfare or juvenile justice.
* Proven ability to develop and revise policies that meet licensing, payer, contractual, and accreditation requirements.
* Ability to communicate effectively, both orally and in written form, with a diverse group of people including regulatory agency representatives, employees, clients, governing body members, and the general public.
* Must be available for travel, to include overnight stays.
* Must have a valid driver’s license.
* Ability to work with computers and the necessary software typically used by the department.

**Physical Requirements (If Applicable)**
=========================================

* Ability to lift up to 25 pounds
* Ability to stand, walk, bend, and assist individuals as needed
* Ability to perform essential job functions with or without reasonable accommodation

**Apply Today**
===============

Some jobs pay the bills. Some jobs build careers. This job changes lives.

If you’re looking for meaningful work where your compassion, dedication, and hard work make a real difference every day, we encourage you to apply today.

**Join our team and become the reason someone has a better day.**

### **About Our Organization**

**Abraxas** is part of the Inperium family of companies.

Employment for this position is administered through Apis Services, Inc.

### **Equal Opportunity Employer**

Apis Services, Inc., Inperium Inc., and affiliates provide equal employment opportunities for all employees and applicants for employment in compliance with all federal and applicable state and local laws and regulations, including nondiscrimination in hiring and employment.

All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, genetic information, marital status, pregnancy, childbirth, veteran status, or any other status protected by law.

This policy of nondiscrimination and equal employment opportunity extends to every phase and aspect of hiring and employment

new_roles.title: Director of Supplier Quality - Operations & Compliance
new_roles.description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

The Director, Supplier Quality – Operations & Compliance reports to the AVP, Supplier Quality and is responsible for developing, maintaining, and optimizing the Supplier Quality Assurance program across Agilent businesses and sites. This role is focused on improving product quality, process quality, supplier performance, and delivery throughout the supply base.

The Director will have direct responsibility for supplier quality processes, standard operating procedures (SOPs), tools, dashboards, key performance indicators (KPIs), and the Approved Supplier List (ASL).

A key priority for this role is developing and implementing a Supplier Quality Operations strategy that centralizes and standardizes processes while ensuring consistent compliance of all processes used in the Supplier Quality organization, including Agilent sites, SQ business leads, SQ category leads, and suppliers.

The successful candidate will be a proactive, self-directed leader who can build strong partnerships across Agilent and the external supply base while driving operational excellence and continuous improvement.

**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**
---------------------------------------

* Own, improve, and standardize supplier quality processes, including supplier Audits, Supplier Corrective Action Requests (SCARs), Supplier Change Management, Supplier Review Boards (SRBs), and Approved Supplier List (ASL) processes.
* Partner closely with Procurement, business and site leadership, Category teams, and other cross-functional stakeholders to ensure effective and consistent execution of supplier quality processes.
* Develop, improve, and continuously monitor a standardized KPI and metrics program, including executive-level dashboards that provide meaningful, actionable visibility into supplier performance and overall supply chain health.
* Present and support Supplier Quality metrics and performance discussions during Quality Management Review (QMR) and Supplier Review Board (SRB) meetings.
* Manage the quality aspects of the Approved Supplier List in partnership with Procurement.
* Identify opportunities for continuous improvement across the Supplier Quality function, establish project ownership, monitor progress, and ensure measurable results at project completion.
* Develop and manage the Supplier Quality outsourcing strategy, including evaluating outsourcing opportunities for audits, root cause analysis (RCA), and other Supplier Quality activities.
* Strengthen the culture of quality and compliance by identifying and implementing continuous improvement opportunities across Supplier Quality processes.
* Partner with Procurement to establish a consistent **"One-Voice Agilent"** approach when communicating with the supply base.
* Evaluate and implement a supplier portal in collaboration with cross-functional stakeholders.
* Engage key supplier management teams through structured business reviews to monitor performance metrics, identify trends, address risks, and implement programs that deliver measurable performance improvements.
* Lead, manage, coach, and develop a high-performing and diverse team of Supplier Quality professionals.
* Own and manage the budget for the Supplier Quality Operations function.
* Strengthen supplier and organizational quality culture through coaching, technical engagement, and collaborative problem-solving.

**Qualifications**
------------------

 

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, or a related discipline preferred.

**Experience**
--------------

 

* 5+ years of direct or related experience in Supplier Quality.
* 3+ years of experience leading and managing teams.
* Experience owning or managing a Quality Management System (QMS), particularly Supplier Quality processes associated with **ISO 9001 and/or ISO 13485**.
* Significant experience with sourcing, supplier management, and quality execution within highly regulated or demanding industries such as medical devices, automotive, aerospace and defense, or similarly complex markets.
* Demonstrated experience working effectively within a matrixed organization.

**Essential Skills & Competencies**
-----------------------------------

 

* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively across organizational levels, functions, cultures, and external organizations.
* Proactive, self-directed leadership style with the ability to identify challenges, develop solutions, and drive implementation.
* Strong commitment to quality, compliance, operational efficiency, and continuous improvement.
* Demonstrated ability to build effective systems and establish trust with suppliers, internal customers, and regulatory stakeholders.
* Proven ability to motivate, coach, and develop team members while fostering collaboration and teamwork.
* Ability to navigate and de-escalate challenging or high-pressure situations calmly and effectively.
* Strong cross-functional leadership and stakeholder-management capabilities.
* Ability to translate supplier and quality data into actionable insights for senior leadership.
* Ability to travel occasionally.

**Additional Details**

This job has a full time weekly schedule. Applications for this job will be accepted until at least November 19, 2026 or until the job is no longer posted.The full-time equivalent pay range for this position is $160,240.00 - $300,450.00/yr USD in the US, or $134,218.00 - $209,715.00/yr CAD in Canada, plus eligibility for bonus, stock and benefits. Our pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Agilent Technologies, Inc., is committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive in the workplace where everyone is welcome, and strives to support candidates with disabilities. If you have a disability and need assistance with any part of the application or interview process or have questions about workplace accessibility, please email job\_posting@agilent.com or contact +1-262-754-5030. The successful candidate will be a proactive, self-directed leader who can build strong partnerships across Agilent and the external supply base while driving operational excellence and continuous improvement.

new_roles.description:
**Quality Director**

**Aerospace Manufacturing | Senior Leadership Team**

**About Columbia Manufacturing**

Columbia Manufacturing, a member of Collective Manufacturing Group, produces complex fabricated components and assemblies for leading aerospace and power generation engine programs. We are committed to delivering safe, reliable, and compliant products while fostering a culture built on integrity, teamwork, accountability, and continuous improvement.

As we continue to grow, we are seeking a Quality Director who will strengthen our quality culture, develop our people, and help ensure we remain a trusted partner to our customers.

**Position Summary**

The Quality Director is a member of the senior leadership team responsible for ensuring Columbia Manufacturing consistently delivers products that meet customer, regulatory, and internal quality requirements.

This role goes beyond compliance. We are seeking a leader who combines sound judgment, ethical decision-making, objective interpretation of requirements, and strong cross-functional leadership. The successful candidate will guide the organization through customer requirements, industry standards, and business challenges while ensuring quality and integrity remain at the center of every decision. We believe strong teams produce strong results, and cultural fit is as important as technical expertise.

The ideal candidate is a collaborative leader who earns trust, develops people, and works effectively with Production, Engineering, Supply Chain, and customers. We value practical experience as highly as formal education and welcome candidates who have built their careers through hands-on manufacturing and quality leadership roles.

**What You’ll Do**

**Lead the Quality Management System**

* Maintain and continuously improve the Quality Management System.
* Ensure compliance with customer, regulatory, and aerospace requirements.
* Promote quality ownership and continuous improvement throughout the organization.

**Guide Quality Decisions**

* Interpret customer specifications, drawings, contractual requirements, and industry standards.
* Provide guidance when requirements are unclear, conflicting, or open to interpretation.
* Lead investigations, corrective actions, and nonconformance resolution using sound judgment and risk-based decision making.

**Partner with Customers and Regulatory Bodies**

* Serve as the primary quality representative to customers, auditors, and regulatory agencies.
* Build trusted relationships and lead internal, customer, and third-party audits.

**Develop People and Culture**

* Lead, mentor, and develop the Quality team.
* Build a high-performing organization through coaching, accountability, and succession planning.
* Foster collaboration and an environment where employees are comfortable raising concerns.
* Promote a culture where doing the right thing is always more important than meeting a schedule.

**Contribute to Business Success**

* Partner with Operations and Leadership to improve performance, reduce risk, strengthen organizational alignment, and support growth.
* Balance customer expectations, business priorities, and compliance requirements without compromising quality standards.
* Exercise independent quality authority and be willing to stop production or shipment when requirements have not been met.

**What We’re Looking For**

We recognize that great leaders come from many backgrounds. Candidates may have developed through engineering, manufacturing, inspection, quality systems, operations, military service, trade programs, or traditional degree pathways. Equivalent combinations of education, military training, trade experience, and hands-on manufacturing or quality leadership experience will be fully considered.

We are less concerned with how you gained your experience and more interested in your ability to lead people, interpret requirements, make sound decisions, and uphold quality standards under pressure.

Successful candidates will typically possess:

* Experience leading quality functions within aerospace, manufacturing, or other highly regulated industries.
* Strong understanding of quality systems, customer requirements, and specification interpretation.
* Demonstrated ethical leadership, sound decision-making, and the ability to uphold standards under pressure.
* Proven success leading teams and collaborating across departments.
* Strong communication skills and experience working with customers, auditors, and senior leadership.
* Continuous improvement mindset and practical problem-solving ability.

**Preferred Experience**

* Familiarity with aerospace quality standards such as AS9100, AS9110, AS13100, NADCAP, or customer-specific requirements.
* Experience supporting OEM customers such as GE Aerospace, Pratt & Whitney, or similar organizations.
* Quality certifications or advanced education are valued but not required.

**Why This Role Matters**

The Quality Director plays a critical role in protecting our customers, our employees, and our reputation. This leader helps ensure that every product we build meets requirements and that every decision we make reflects our commitment to integrity, accountability, and continuous improvement.

**If you are a leader who values ethics, teamwork, sound judgment, and building strong people and processes, we encourage you to apply.**

new_roles.title: Director of Quality
new_roles.description:
Job Summary:

### **Position Summary**

The Director of Quality is an execution-focused leader responsible for translating WellBe’s enterprise quality strategy into disciplined, measurable operations across markets and health plan contracts.

This role leads the day-to-day Quality function, manages and develops team members, and redesigns care-gap closure workflows to be simpler, standardized, scalable, and integrated into clinical practice.

The Director partners closely with market, clinical, pharmacy, analytics, technology, coding, and health plan stakeholders to improve HEDIS and Medicare Advantage Stars performance, strengthen data reliability, increase frontline accountability, and ensure the organization consistently converts quality insights into action.

Job Description:

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities** 
Lead day-to-day execution of the Quality program across Part C and Part D, converting enterprise goals into clear workplans, owners, timelines, operating rhythms, and measurable results. 
Directly manage, coach, and performance-manage Quality team members; establish clear productivity, quality, service, and accountability standards. 
Map end-to-end care-gap closure workflows across measures, markets, and health plan contracts; identify handoffs, rework, manual steps, failure points, and unnecessary variation. 
Redesign and standardize workflows so care-gap identification, outreach, documentation, closure, submission, and reconciliation are consistently executed and sustainable at scale. 
Engage Markets using structured working sessions that diagnose barriers, assign actions, monitor commitments, and drive closure at the patient, provider, measure, and market levels. 
Partner with clinical operations and technology teams to surface prioritized care gaps at the point of care and embed closure activities into APP workflows. 
Lead implementation and adoption of Quality workflow tools, including in-house technologies, point-of-care solutions, telephony or workforce-management tools, and future AI-enabled capabilities. 
Oversee HEDIS chart abstraction, primary source validation, medical record retrieval, supplemental data submissions, and health plan audit support, with an emphasis on accuracy, timeliness, and reduced manual effort. 
Manage medication adherence and other Part D outreach operations; use performance and workflow data to improve productivity, assess capacity, and inform staffing decisions. 
Partner with analytics, IT, and health plan teams to strengthen WellBe-owned quality reporting using claims, EMR, pharmacy, and supplemental data; reconcile numerator, denominator, timing, and data-integrity differences. 
Use market-, provider-, measure-, and patient-level data to prioritize interventions, forecast performance, monitor outcomes, and adjust tactics quickly when results are off track. 
Evaluate and implement practical automation and AI-assisted solutions that reduce repetitive work, improve chart-review efficiency, and allow the team to focus on higher-value intervention and market partnership. 
Own point-of-care solution assessment and implementation, including identification of operational pain points, vendor coordination, rollout planning, training, adoption, and performance monitoring. 
Maintain current knowledge of NCQA, HEDIS, CMS, Stars, and applicable health plan requirements; ensure workflows, documentation, submissions, and controls remain compliant. 
Build effective cross-functional relationships and drive decisions with stakeholders across clinical operations, pharmacy, coding, analytics, technology, finance, compliance, markets, and external vendors.

Job Requirements:

### **Required Qualifications**

**Education:** Bachelor’s degree in nursing, healthcare administration, public health, health sciences, business, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

**Experience:** Seven or more years of progressive experience in healthcare quality, managed care, provider operations, population health, HEDIS, or Medicare Advantage Stars, including 3–5 years of people-management experience. Demonstrated experience setting expectations, coaching team members, managing performance, delivering measurable operational results, and mapping, redesigning, implementing, and sustaining complex workflows across multiple teams, markets, or contracts.

**Skills:** Strong working knowledge of NCQA HEDIS specifications, Medicare Advantage Stars, care-gap closure, medical record review, supplemental data, and quality operations. Proven ability to move between strategy and execution, manage multiple priorities, remove barriers, and deliver results in a fast-paced, matrixed organization. Strong people leadership, change-management, project-management, process-improvement, problem-solving, and written and verbal communication skills. Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel and presentation tools; experience with workflow platforms, reporting tools, automation, or AI-enabled healthcare solutions preferred. High attention to detail, sound judgment, and the ability to maintain confidentiality.

### **Physical and Mental Requirements**

* Ability to stand or sit for extended periods.
* Visual acuity and fine motor.
* Ability to travel locally or nationally as needed.

### **Work Environment**

This role operates in a corporate, primarily remote environment and requires frequent collaboration across functions, markets, and external partners. Occasional travel and schedule flexibility may be required to support market operations, implementations, audits, and business priorities. No routine on-call responsibilities are expected.

### **Sponsorship Statement**

WellBe does not offer employment-based visa sponsorship for this position. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship now or in the future.

### **Pay Transparency Statement**

Compensation for this position will be disclosed in accordance with applicable state and local pay transparency laws.

### **Safety-Sensitive Statement**

This position has been designated as safety-sensitive. As such, the employee must be able to perform job duties in a manner that ensures the safety of themselves, coworkers, patients, and the public. The role requires full cognitive and physical functioning at all times.

Employees in safety-sensitive positions are subject to drug and alcohol testing, including for substances that may impair judgment or motor function, in accordance with applicable federal and state laws and company policy. Due to the safety-sensitive nature of this role and in alignment with federal law and workplace safety standards, the use of marijuana—including medical or recreational use—is prohibited. WellBe Senior Medical will comply with applicable state laws regarding medical marijuana and reasonable accommodations, where such laws do not conflict with safety requirements or federal regulations.

### **Drug Screening Requirement**

As a condition of employment, WellBe Senior Medical requires all candidates to successfully complete a pre-employment drug screening. Ongoing employment may also be contingent upon compliance with the company’s Drug-Free Workplace Policy, which includes random, post-accident, and reasonable suspicion drug testing. The company reserves the right to test for substances that may impair an employee’s ability to safely and effectively perform their job duties.

### **Background Check Statement**

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check, as permitted by law. As a healthcare organization, WellBe conducts monthly FACIS (Fraud and Abuse Control Information System) checks on all employees. Continued employment is contingent upon satisfactory results of these checks, in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.

### **Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Statement**

WellBe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

### **Americans with Disabilities Act**

WellBe Senior Medical is committed to complying with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and applicable state and local laws. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job. If you require an accommodation during the application, interview or employment process, please contact Human Resources at HRPeopleLine@wellbe.com

### **At-Will Employment Statement**

Employment with WellBe is at-will unless otherwise specified by contract. This job description does not constitute an employment contract.

### **Disclaimer**

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required. Management reserves the right to modify, add, or remove duties as necessary.

new_roles.description:
**Deputy Director of Launch Production**

**Purpose:**

* Valkyrie Enterprises is seeking a **Deputy Director of Launch Production** in **Huntsville, AL**, to oversee the planning, execution, and delivery of launch production programs in support of Department of War (DoW) customers.

**Job Description:**

* Manage all aspects of launch production programs, including technical performance, cost, schedule, contract requirements, and program deliverables.
* Lead and coordinate cross-functional teams, including engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, logistics, and support services, to ensure successful program execution.
* Develop and maintain program plans, schedules, budgets, and performance metrics to ensure program milestones and customer requirements are met.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for customers and internal stakeholders, providing regular updates on program performance, schedules, risks, and deliverables.
* Monitor program performance, identify potential risks, and implement corrective actions to ensure successful execution within established budgets and timelines.
* Support the development and implementation of a 5-year strategic plan for launcher and launch services across the DoW, including ground-based, sea-based, and air-launched capabilities.
* Support business development and capture activities, including identifying new opportunities, developing proposals, and supporting FAR-based contracts, Other Transaction Agreements (OTAs), and task orders.
* Manage program financial performance, including budgeting, forecasting, resource allocation, and profitability.
* Work closely with company leadership to align program objectives with customer requirements and organizational goals.
* Provide leadership and oversight of program personnel, including staffing, resource planning, and team performance.

**Qualifications:**

* Must have a Bachelor's Degree in a STEM field and at least 20 years of relevant experience supporting DoW programs or projects.
* Must have demonstrated experience managing complex defense programs, including cost, schedule, technical performance, and contract execution.
* Must have experience leading cross-functional teams and coordinating technical, manufacturing, and production activities.
* Must have experience managing program budgets, financial performance, forecasting, and resource allocation.
* Must have experience executing government contracts, including FAR-based contracts, OTAs, and task orders.
* Must have demonstrated experience managing customer relationships and ensuring successful delivery of contractual requirements.
* Must have experience supporting business development, proposal development, and capture efforts.
* Must have demonstrated leadership experience, including personnel management, staffing, and organizational growth.
* Must be a self-starter with strong organizational, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Must have strong oral and written communication skills.
* Must be proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, and PowerPoint).

**Desired Qualifications:**

* Advanced degree preferred.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification preferred.
* Experience managing missile, launcher, or defense production programs preferred.
* Top Secret/SCI security clearance preferred.

**Security Requirements:**

* Must have an Active Secret Clearance and the ability to maintain the clearance.

**Travel Requirements:**

* Travel – 25%.
* If position requires travel by domestic flight or access to secure federal facilities/military bases, candidate must be able to obtain (by start of position) and maintain appropriate identification credentials, such as REAL ID. (More information regarding REAL ID can be found: https://www.dhs.gov/real-id)

**Physical Requirements:**

* Remaining in a stationary position, often standing or sitting for prolonged periods.
* Able to sit and work on a computer for long periods of time.
* Moving about to accomplish tasks or moving from one worksite to another.
* Communicating with others to exchange information.
* Light work that includes moving objects up to 20 pounds.

**Pre-Employment Requirements:**

Any offer of employment with Valkyrie Enterprises is contingent upon the successful completion of all applicable pre-employment requirements. Depending on the position, these may include a criminal background investigation, employment and education verification, pre-employment drug screening, driving record review, security clearance eligibility, government installation access, and any other customer or contract-specific requirements. Failure to successfully meet any required pre-employment condition may result in the withdrawal of the contingent offer of employment.

**Valkyrie strictly adheres to a policy of equal employment opportunity. This policy is based on Valkyrie’s commitment to hire and retain qualified employees consistent with position requirements; and to seek, employ, promote and treat all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religious creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, pregnancy, childbirth, physical disability, mental disability, age, military status or protected veteran status, marital status, registered domestic partner or civil union status, gender (including sex stereotyping and gender identity or expression), medical condition, genetic information or sexual orientation or other protected characteristics.**

Additionally, Valkyrie Enterprises provides a variety of benefits to eligible employees to support your best health, wellness, and future, to include medical/dental/vision options, company paid life and disability insurances, 401k with match, education reimbursement, as well as company paid holidays and paid time off (PTO).

new_roles.title: Director of Production Planning
new_roles.description:
Karman Space & Defense is a leader in the rapid design, development, and production of critical, next-generation system solutions that align with the U.S. Department of War and its allies' core mission priorities, and meet the accelerating demand for access to space. Building on nearly 50 years of success, we deliver Payload & Protection Systems, Aero/Hydrodynamic Interstage Systems, and Propulsion & Launch Systems to more than 80 prime contractors supporting over 130 space and defense programs.

This role is part of our Space and Launch business, which has contributed to the nation's space programs for decades by delivering complete solutions from concept to flight. We enable successful space operations with mission-critical technology supporting every step from first launch to final landing, including launch vehicle subsystems, propulsion systems, aerodynamic and interstage systems, and payload protection and deployment. Our high-performance solutions are engineered to operate in the most extreme environments and meet precise mission requirements.

The Director of Production Planning leads the enterprise production planning and scheduling operating system across Karman's manufacturing operations. In this role, you will transform customer demand and Sales, Inventory and Operations Planning (SIOP) outputs into executable production plans, capacity strategies, and recovery actions that support on-time delivery and predictable execution while providing visibility into risks, constraints, and opportunities across the manufacturing network.

**Responsibilities**

* Leads production planning, master scheduling, and finite-capacity planning across Karman manufacturing sites and value streams.
* Translates customer demand, backlog, and Sales, Inventory and Operations Planning (SIOP) outputs into achievable production schedules with clear priorities, constraints, and recovery plans.
* Establishes planning standards and key performance indicators (KPIs) for schedule adherence, on-time delivery, past-due backlog, work-in-process (WIP) aging, capacity utilization, and plan attainment.
* Partners with Operations and Manufacturing Engineering to align labor, equipment, tooling, and process capacity with production requirements.
* Coordinates with Supply Chain to identify material shortages, supplier constraints, and outside-processing risks before they affect production performance.
* Leads schedule recovery and re-baselining efforts when demand, material availability, quality issues, or capacity changes create delivery risk.
* Ensures enterprise resource planning (ERP), material requirements planning (MRP), and planning data are accurate, timely, and aligned with approved operating plans.
* Develops planners and schedulers while building a high-accountability planning organization.
* Provides executive visibility into delivery risk, capacity gaps, staffing needs, and critical decisions required to protect customer commitments.
* Improves end-to-end SIOP, planning, scheduling, and production-control processes.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Engineering, Business, or a related field.
* 10+ years of production planning, master scheduling, operations planning, or supply chain experience in a manufacturing environment.
* 5+ years of leadership experience managing planning, scheduling, or production-control teams.
* Demonstrated experience with ERP, MRP, master production schedules, capacity planning, and material requirements planning.
* Strong analytical skills and experience leading cross-functional delivery-recovery plans.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in aerospace, defense, space, or other highly regulated manufacturing environments.
* Experience with SIOP, Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP), Power BI, or advanced manufacturing analytics.
* Knowledge of AS9100 and configuration-controlled manufacturing environments.

**Physical Requirements**

* Frequently communicates and works with employees in office and manufacturing environments.
* Frequently stands, walks, and uses a computer; occasionally bends, reaches, or moves throughout production areas as required by the role.
* The essential functions of this position must be performed with or without reasonable accommodation.

**Special Mentions**

* Frequent (25–50%) travel may be required to support Karman manufacturing sites.

This position requires U.S. person status under U.S. export control laws, including U.S. citizens and nationals, lawful permanent residents, refugees, and asylees.

**Benefits**

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid time off
* Health Savings Account (HSA) with company contribution
* Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
* Company‑paid life and AD&D insurance
* Short‑ and long‑term disability coverage
* Tuition reimbursement

Karman Space and Defense is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.
