new_roles.title: Operations Director
new_roles.description:
Job Overview

The Operations Director will oversee the company's day to day operations and work closely with leadership to ensure that business objectives are being met. This role is responsible for managing operational performance, supporting department managers, improving internal processes, and making sure teams have the direction and resources they need to do their jobs effectively.

You will work across finance, sales, customer service, and project management to keep business activities organized and running smoothly. The right person understands how to manage people and resources, keep an eye on financial performance, and address operational problems before they affect the business.

Responsibilities

Oversee daily business operations and work with department managers to establish priorities, assign responsibilities, and maintain consistent performance across teams.

Monitor profit and loss performance, review operating expenses, and work with finance to manage budgets and improve financial results.

Use financial reports, operational data, and Microsoft Excel to evaluate performance, identify problems, and support day to day business decisions.

Manage operational projects and process improvement initiatives, looking for practical ways to reduce unnecessary costs, improve efficiency, and strengthen service delivery.

Work with sales, business development, and customer service teams to coordinate activities and ensure that operational priorities support the company's business goals.

Review existing procedures and introduce improvements where needed, including the use of lean management principles to improve workflow and resource utilization.

Manage and support department managers, provide clear direction, and follow up on operational responsibilities and performance.

Work with senior leadership on business planning, resource allocation, and decisions that affect the company's operations and long term development.

Address operational challenges, resolve internal coordination issues, and ensure that important projects and business activities stay on track.

Experience and Qualifications

Demonstrated experience in operations management, business management, or a related management position, with a strong record of supervising teams and overseeing daily business activities.

Experience managing department managers, coordinating multiple business functions, and maintaining accountability across an organization.

Strong understanding of financial management, profit and loss oversight, operating budgets, and financial performance analysis.

Ability to interpret financial reports, analyze operational data, and use Microsoft Excel to support business decisions.

Experience with strategic planning, project management, process improvement, and operational performance management.

Strong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to guide managers, develop employees, and address business challenges.

A practical understanding of sales operations, business development, and customer service.

Familiarity with lean management principles and continuous improvement practices is valuable.

Good organizational skills, sound business judgment, and the ability to manage competing priorities while keeping teams focused on results.

Pay: $158,200.00 - $222,200.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Employee discount
* Flexible schedule
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Professional development assistance
* Referral program
* Retirement plan
* Tuition reimbursement
* Vision insurance

Flexim Group is seeking an experienced Global Account Operations Manager to provide senior operational leadership for a strategic international account operating across complex sites and manufacturing environments.

Based in Jersey City, you will hold global accountability for operational performance across the account, leading regional and site teams to deliver consistent FM and technical services, safety, compliance and business continuity.

This is a management operations role requiring strong experience, technical credibility and the ability to lead through senior regional and site operations teams. You will set operational standards, challenge performance, manage critical escalations and translate global client priorities into disciplined execution across countries and facilities.

**Duties**

* Lead global operational performance across a complex, multi-country manufacturing account.
* Lead and challenge regional and site Operations Managers, ensuring clear accountability and consistent execution.
* Drive services excellence, with a strong focus on asset reliability, maintenance, utilities and critical infrastructure.
* Establish and enforce global operational standards, while ensuring effective implementation at regional and site level.
* Monitor and challenge operational performance through KPIs, SLAs, CMMS/BMS data, maintenance completion, backlog and asset uptime.
* Lead critical operational escalations.
* Drive continuous improvement and operational excellence, identifying opportunities to improve reliability, efficiency, service quality and cost performance.
* Lead global account financial performance, including budgeting, forecasting, cost control and profitability.
* Partner with senior client stakeholders, translating strategic objectives into operational priorities and measurable results.
* Act as the senior operational authority for the account, providing executive-level governance, reporting and decision-making.

**Experience**

* Substantial operational leadership experience in Integrated Facilities Management, ideally across a multi-country portfolio.
* Strong working knowledge of hard FM and building engineering services
* Demonstrated experience controlling SLAs, KPIs, CMMS workflows, asset registers, maintenance backlogs and technical compliance.
* Proven ownership of account P&L, budgeting, forecasting, subcontractor costs and commercial change control.
* Experience leading dispersed operational teams and managing specialist service providers across different regulatory environments.
* Confident client-facing leadership, supported by operational discipline, sound judgement and a willingness to be present on site.
* Significant leadership experience within Integrated Facilities Management.
* Proven success managing complex global or multi-country client accounts.
* Strong executive stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.
* Strong understanding of operational excellence, governance and performance management.
* Excellent communication, negotiation and influencing skills.
* A proactive, accountable and client-centric leadership style.

Pay: $135,000.00 - $150,000.00 per year

* 401(k)

* Flexible schedule

* Paid time off

new_roles.title: Director, Practice Operations Framingham and Norfolk
new_roles.description:
**About Tufts Medicine**

Tufts Medicine brings together the best of academic and community medicine to deliver exceptional, connected and accessible care. Comprised of Tufts Medical Center, the principal teaching hospital of Tufts University and the Tufts University School of Medicine, Lowell General Hospital, MelroseWakefield Hospital, Lawrence Memorial Hospital of Medford, Care at Home, and an integrated network of 2,300 physicians, we treat the most complex conditions, keep our communities healthy and bring research breakthroughs to life.

**Job Overview**

This position reports to the Vice President of the Community Practice Operations (South and West) & Network Integration and serves as a key leader within Ambulatory at Tufts Medicine. The role provides operational and strategic oversight across the West region and in alignment with Ambulatory within the broader Tufts network.

In addition, this leader will oversee the Tufts Medicine Multi-Specialty location in Framingham, as well as Norfolk, including not only operations, but also growth within these practices. Operating within a collaborative leadership model and with a focus on service excellence in the ambulatory environment, this position is accountable for:

* Ensuring high-quality patient access and experience
* Driving financial performance and profitability
* Optimizing all revenue cycle processes
* Advancing strategic initiatives across the region and potentially across Ambulatory as a whole, when designated

This role plays a critical part in shaping the Tufts Medicine ambulatory strategy, enhancing operational effectiveness, and supporting the delivery and expansion of exceptional care within the community.

Location: Hybrid and at sites within the designated region (e.g., Framingham & Norfolk)

**Job Description**

**Minimum Qualifications:**

1. Bachelor's degree in business, healthcare, or a related field or equivalent combination of education and experience such as Associate’s degree in business, healthcare, or a related field and two (2) years of relevant business experience or High School Diploma or GED and four (4) years of relevant business experience.

2. Seven (7) years of healthcare management or practice management experience working directly with physicians and practice members.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

1. Master’s degree in business, healthcare, or a related field.

2. Ten (10) years of healthcare management or practice management experience working directly with physicians and practice members.

**Duties and Responsibilities:** The duties and responsibilities listed below are intended to describe the general nature of work and are not intended to be an all-inclusive list. Other duties and responsibilities may be assigned.

1. Directs the practice operations managers in the day-to-day operations of their employed outpatient physician practices to ensure each practice is meeting optimal operational efficiency, fiscal stability and patient/employee satisfaction.

2. Collaborates with the practice operations managers in the implementation of best practice models in all areas of practices operations. Develops guidelines for prioritizing work activities, evaluating effectiveness and modifying activities as necessary.

3. Evaluates practice efficiency including all personnel (physicians, clinical and administrative support staff) utilizing accepted quality measures, productivity standards, skill mix comparisons, and patient satisfaction survey data. Implements new operational models and structures to reduce cost, improve efficiency and quality, and enhance services to patients.

4. Participates in the development of and oversees budgets for the practices. Reviews monthly P&L reports in detail, determines opportunities for improvements, and creates and implements action plans with practice operations managers as necessary.

5. Conducts monthly operations team meetings to review new policies and procedures, processes, quality measures, etc., and monthly one-on-one meetings with each practice manager at each practice location to provide individual support and leadership.

6. Initiates and maintains all policy and procedure manuals. Develops and implements standardized processes for practices to ensure consistency throughout the physician network. Works with practice operations managers to ensure practices meet required compliance and clinical competency thresholds.

7. Works collaboratively with the physician recruitment team on the provider enrollment onboarding activities related to new practice acquisitions or new employed providers. Works closely with the provider recruitment team, practice operations manager and provider(s) throughout the onboarding life cycle to ensure timeliness and deliverables are met for a seamless transition and successful implementation.

8. In collaboration with the Vice President of Physician Services, implements the transition plan for newly acquired physician practices. Acts as liaison to physicians, support staff, operations team, hospital departments, and hospital administration. Responsible for the human resources, payroll, finance, and purchasing components of the acquisitions.

9. Works collaboratively with representatives from the physician organizations to ensure that our practices and providers are achieving a high level of performance under managed risk contracts as we transition to a value-based model. Commitment to transformation and innovation in care delivery through the Practice of the Future work will also be a measure of success.

**Physical Requirements:**

1. Work environment: professional office environment with typical office requirements such as computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets, etc.

2. Frequently required to speak, hear, communicate and exchange information.

3. Able to see and read computers displays, read fine print, and/or normal type size print and distinguish letters, numbers and symbols.

4. Occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.

5. Ability to work in confined or open environments.

6. Ability to work independently or in a team environment.

7. Ability to travel to various locations both within the state and outside the state.

**Skills & Abilities:**

1. Demonstrates leadership style that emphasizes openness, visibility and connectivity.

2. Ability to convey the organization’s enthusiasm, confidence, goals, and mission and inspire those things in others.

3. Ability to connect with people in a meaningful way at all levels within the organization in keeping with the culture of the senior leadership team.

4. Demonstrates forward thinking and creativity with high ethical standards and an appropriate professional image while fostering collaboration and building consensus to achieve collective objectives.

5. Ability to make tough choices that serve the best interests of the organization. Proven creative problem-solving skills with the willingness to take the initiative in leading change as well as the ability to effectively manage change.

6. Ability to build consensus with strong negotiation, persuasion and communication skills to propose enhancements to operational processes to improve efficiency and/or effectiveness.

7. Demonstrates strong interpersonal skills necessary to engage effectively at all levels for effecting timely progress.

8. Ability to be an innovative problem solver with excellent critical thinking skills.

9. Demonstrates exemplary leadership and stakeholder management expertise.

10. Ability to hold self and others accountable to meet deadlines and achieve business goals.

**Job Profile Summary**

This role focuses on providing administrative and business support to the organization in order to achieve operational goals. In addition, this role focuses on performing the following Clinical Administration duties: Long-term strategic planning, determines strategic issues and opportunities that could affect practice success, prioritizes and tracks investments across practices, allocates resources and makes decisions regarding practice growth, and develops need to accomplish the practice's vision. A management role that supervises employees focusing on tactical, operational activities within a specified area, with the majority of time spent overseeing area of responsibility, planning, prioritizing and/or directing the responsibilities of employees. Goal achievement is typically accomplished through performance of direct and/or indirect reports. A role that directs a department or small unit that includes multiple teams led by managers and/or team Leaders. new_roles.title: Director, Operational Excellence
new_roles.description:
The Director, Operational Excellence will focus on delivery excellence, process optimization, resource management, and stakeholder management. The Director will be an operational leader who develops frameworks and effective ways of working on which our organization can build in the coming years. This includes ownership of organizational resource tracking, resource planning, hiring process support, and staff augmentation vendor management, so the organization has the right talent in the right roles at the right time in line with funds planning. The Director and team will ensure that the organization develops and fully integrates a continuous improvement culture, with the ultimate goal of ensuring team efficiency, and financial effectiveness.

 

* Leads priorities focused on service delivery and capability alignment, resource management, budget/financial management, vendor and technology management, communications, and training
* Partners with the Leadership Team in short- and long-term planning activities that align with the organization’s strategy, vision, operational plan, and goals
* Establishes and maintains organization-wide resource tracking, providing visibility into headcount, allocation, capacity, utilization, and cost across colleagues and contingent workers
* Leads resource planning in partnership with the Leadership Team and Finance, forecasting demand, identifying capability and capacity gaps, and recommending the right mix of full-time and augmented staff
* Supports hiring processes in partnership with Talent Acquisition and PX, including position requests and approvals, job description development, requisition tracking, interview coordination, and onboarding readiness
* Manages processes related to staff augmentation vendors, including vendor selection, rate and contract negotiation, performance management, and spend oversight
* Drives innovative thinking and planning, leveraging new technologies as needed, to address the needs of the organization and its individual capabilities
* Challenges the status quo and drives continuous improvement by establishing a solid foundation and implementing standard ways of working, systems, processes, and frameworks.
* Works closely with cross-functional peers and team members to consolidate efforts for org processes improvements, but also applies independent decision making to ensure best possible approach is being implemented.
* Promotes a continuous improvement mindset and process improvement initiatives through communication, training, and best practices, ensuring accountability through governance.
* Has critical impact on significant reduction of administrative and redundant tasks across Engineering & Technology organization through applying most efficient and suitable AI tools and bringing in innovative ways of working.
* Builds, develops, and grows relationships with internal and external stakeholders and vendors at every level
* Serves as strategic program/project manager for key organizational projects. Has direct accountability for budget assigned to these projects and management of related vendors, supports oversight processes for organizational budget.
* Coaches, mentors, and supports the professional growth of direct reports. Responsible for efficient resource and funds allocation within the team.

**Basic Qualifications**

Bachelors degree and 8+ years relevant work experience

Strong written and verbal communication skills and interpersonal, collaboration, and facilitation skills

Proven analytical and critical thinking skills, and strong background in process improvement

Practical experience with operational, process improvement, gaining efficiencies and project management methodologies and ability to lead project teams

Ability to multi-task and handle multiple priorities while managing aggressive deadlines

Strong ability for independent decision making while working closely with cross-functional peers

Demonstrated ability to manage/lead complex projects, including resource and budget management for assigned projects

**Preferred Qualifications**

Masters degree in related field

Pharmaceutical or Healthcare industry experience

Practical experience with organization setup processes that include job descriptions creation, managing hiring processes with human resources, sourcing contracted resources.

Project Management Professional (PMP) and/or Lean Six Sigma Black Belt (LSSBB)

Knowledge of or expertise in Digital product development and/or Design Thinking

Experience driving change in a global, matrixed organization

Candidate demonstrates a breadth of diverse leadership experiences and capabilities including: the ability to influence and collaborate with peers, develop and coach others, oversee and guide the work of other colleagues to achieve meaningful outcomes and create business impact.

**NON-STANDARD WORK SCHEDULE, TRAVEL OR ENVIRONMENT REQUIREMENTS**

National and International travel may be necessary

Work Location Assignment: Hybrid

Last Date to Apply for Job: 11/30/2026

new_roles.title: Strategic Operations Director
new_roles.description:
**Location:** New York, NY 
**Compensation:** $170,000 - $190,000 base salary + annual bonus 
**Travel:** 25%

In 2017, Shields established the Strategic Operations team to partner directly with the Executive Leadership Team in executing the company's highest-priority initiatives. These efforts span corporate strategy, operational transformation, performance improvement, growth execution, business development, and new business innovation. Team members gain exposure to all aspects of the organization, combining executive-level engagement with hands-on responsibility for translating strategy into measurable results. The team has served as a pathway to leadership, with alumni advancing into senior roles across Strategy, Operations, Finance, and Executive Leadership. This role offers the opportunity to build on that legacy while helping shape Shields' next phase of growth and innovation.

The **Director of Strategic Operations** serves as a senior leader responsible for driving strategic initiatives, operational excellence, and growth across Shields' portfolio of health system specialty pharmacy partnerships. This role is ideal for individuals with experience as a **Healthcare Consulting Engagement Manager, Healthcare Strategy Leader, Strategic Operations Leader, Transformation Leader, Management Consultant, or operations executive within a private equity-backed healthcare services organization** seeking an opportunity to influence enterprise-level decision-making and organizational performance.

Leading a team of high-performing professionals, the Director will oversee complex cross-functional initiatives, deliver executive-level analyses and recommendations, and partner directly with senior leaders to drive exceptional clinical, operational, and financial outcomes. Functioning as an internal strategy and operations leader, this individual will identify growth opportunities, solve complex business challenges, and translate strategic priorities into measurable results across the organization.

This role is particularly well suited for professionals coming from **healthcare consulting, management consulting, healthcare strategy, portfolio operations, business transformation, performance improvement, or private equity-backed healthcare organizations** who are looking for the opportunity to move beyond recommendations and directly own execution. Success requires strong strategic thinking, structured problem solving, financial and operational acumen, executive presence, and the ability to influence stakeholders across a fast-paced, high-growth healthcare environment.

The ideal candidate is a highly analytical and resourceful leader who thrives in entrepreneurial settings, excels at managing ambiguity, and has a demonstrated track record of leading strategic initiatives that drive growth, value creation, operational excellence, and performance improvement.

**Job Duties**

Strategic Leadership & Team Development

* Serve as a key leader within the Strategic Operations team, driving growth, strategic execution, and organizational performance through both direct leadership and individual contributions.
* Lead, coach, and develop a team of high-performing professionals responsible for supporting critical business initiatives across the organization.
* Oversee the planning, execution, and monitoring of strategic and operational initiatives aligned with Shields' highest-priority objectives.
* Synthesize complex operational, financial, and market insights into clear, actionable recommendations for executive leadership.
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and professional development.

### **Strategy, Operations & Performance Improvement**

* Partner directly with Senior Vice Presidents and Regional Vice Presidents of Operations to drive strong financial, operational, and clinical outcomes across Shields' health system partnerships.
* Collaborate with operational leadership to identify, prioritize, and execute strategic objectives while ensuring alignment with organizational goals.
* Lead day-to-day strategy and operational execution for a portfolio of health system partnerships.
* Develop business cases, financial models, forecasts, and performance analyses to support executive decision-making.
* Drive high-impact initiatives focused on operational excellence, growth strategy, performance improvement, transformation, and value creation.
* Conduct analyses to identify opportunities for revenue growth, cost optimization, process improvement, and partnership expansion.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to senior operational leaders, providing strategic guidance and analytical support.
* Facilitate cross-functional collaboration across Operations, Finance, Business Development, Clinical, Technology, Human Resources, and Executive Leadership teams.

### **Partnership & Stakeholder Management**

* Own and cultivate relationships with senior health system executives and key external stakeholders.
* Act as a strategic liaison between Shields leadership and health system partners to ensure alignment on priorities and objectives.
* Support executive presentations, partnership reviews, business planning sessions, and strategic steering committees.
* Translate complex analyses into compelling executive-level presentations and recommendations.

### **Growth & Innovation**

* Identify, evaluate, and pursue new business opportunities, ancillary services, operational enhancements, and growth initiatives that increase partnership value.
* Support strategic planning, business development, market expansion, and innovation efforts across the organization.
* Evaluate market trends, competitive dynamics, and emerging healthcare opportunities to inform strategic decision-making.

Education & Experience

* Bachelor's degree required; MBA, MHA, MPH, or other advanced degree strongly preferred.
* 8+ years of professional experience with a demonstrated track record of strategic and operational leadership within healthcare.
* Experience in one or more of the following environments strongly preferred:
 + **Healthcare Consulting Firms** (Engagement Manager, Manager, Project Leader, Senior Manager, Principal, or equivalent roles)
 + **Private Equity-Backed Healthcare Services Organizations**
 + **Corporate Strategy, Strategic Operations, Transformation, Portfolio Operations, or Performance Improvement Functions**
 + **Health Systems, Specialty Pharmacy, Provider Services, Population Health, Revenue Cycle, or Healthcare Services Organizations**
* Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional initiatives from strategy development through implementation and performance measurement.
* Proven ability to drive operational excellence, business transformation, growth strategy, and performance improvement initiatives in complex healthcare environments.
* Experience developing and presenting strategic recommendations, performance updates, and business insights to executive leadership teams and Board-level audiences.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint, including financial modeling, scenario analysis, business case development, forecasting, and executive-level presentations.
* Strong analytical and quantitative skills with the ability to solve complex business problems using data-driven approaches.
* Demonstrated success influencing senior stakeholders and leading through influence in highly matrixed organizations.
* Proven self-starter with the ability to operate independently, manage ambiguity, and deliver results in fast-paced environments.
* Exceptional organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple strategic initiatives and workstreams simultaneously.
* Outstanding written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Healthcare industry experience strongly preferred.
* Willingness to travel approximately 25% to engage with health system executives, operational leaders, pharmacists, clinicians, and partnership stakeholders.

 
**Why Join Shields?**

* Partner directly with Executive Leadership on the company's most important strategic priorities.
* Lead high-impact initiatives that drive growth, operational excellence, and transformative outcomes across a national network of health system partnerships.
* Gain broad exposure to corporate strategy, healthcare operations, business development, and executive decision-making.
* Join a proven leadership pipeline that has developed future leaders across Strategy, Operations, Finance, and Executive Leadership.
* Help shape the future of healthcare through innovative specialty pharmacy solutions that improve patient outcomes and strengthen health system partnerships.

The Director of Operations – Restaurants is responsible for overseeing effective operating procedures within the restaurant while developing a successful management team.

**Daily Responsibilities**

* Plan and direct administration and planning functions of the Food & Beverage department to meet the daily needs of the operation.
* Clearly describe, assign, and delegate responsibility and authority for the operation of the various food & beverage positions.
* Possesses knowledge of all front-of-house job duties.
* Provides financial oversight and prepares and presents financial and operations reports.
* Possesses in-depth knowledge of all operational systems in use including but not limited to payroll, inventory and purchasing.
* Ensures that all mechanical systems are in good working order and compliant with all federal, state and local ordinances.
* Regulates all executive-level POS functions.
* Oversee and supervise the execution of front-of-house operations to ensure quality, safety, efficiency, and profitability.
* Assists managers in establishing and achieving predetermined profit objectives and desired standards of quality of food, service, cleanliness and promotion.
* Responsible, with the Executive Chef and General Manager, for maintaining the venue’s monthly Profit & Loss statement standards while meeting or exceeding budget expectations through controlling P&L items.
* Oversees that training programs are in place for employees to update their knowledge on relevant industry practices.
* Oversees that the venue is compliant with all federal, state, and local laws and regulations and company policies.
* Possesses in-depth knowledge of all food and beverage menus.
* Oversees that all guest and employee concerns are resolved in a way that promotes guest retention.
* Oversees the replacement or repair of all breakage or damage of equipment, furniture, or other company property.
* Ensures front-of-house employees follow all policies and procedures by providing clear guidelines and expectations.
* Maintain professional appearance standards as directed in the Employee Handbook.
* Anticipates and accommodates needs of guests while providing professional and exceptional service to ensure guest satisfaction.
* Protects establishment, guests, and employees by adhering to and overseeing that the Department of Health and company sanitation standards are followed.
* Responsible for management interviewing, hiring, and training process decisions.
* Coaches front-of-house managers as needed and assists in their professional development.

**Physical Requirements**

* Must be able to stand, walk, lift, and bend for extended periods of time.
* Must be able to bend and lift up to 50 lbs.
* Role may include job duties or tasks requiring repetitive motions.
* Exposure to hot kitchen elements or cleaning materials.

**Skills/Experience**

* Minimum five (5) years’ experience working in a general management role in hospitality/nightlife/ bars.
* Passionate about hospitality, food and beverage and morale/culture.
* Ability to think proactively and creatively, have decision making and analytical skills and be effective in written and verbal communication.
* Self-motivated with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, effectively multi-task, and drive results.
* Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills.
* Ability to work a flexible schedule including evenings, weekends, and holidays when required.

*We are an equal opportunity employer.*

new_roles.description:
**Job Overview**

The Director of Operations leads business operations and operations management, turning strategic plans into clear priorities and effective execution. You’ll guide executive-level teams, manage budgets and financial performance, and strengthen processes across the organization. This role calls for confident leadership, sound judgment, and a practical, data-driven approach to change and growth.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead operational excellence initiatives, process improvement, and operational analysis to improve business performance.
* Direct strategic planning, project management, and program management, aligning work with organizational priorities.
* Oversee executive-level budget management, financial management, budgeting, forecasting, and profit and loss analysis.
* Manage business development and business development management, identifying opportunities and coordinating execution.
* Lead change management, including large-scale organizational change, and communicate plans and progress clearly to executives. Your impact: Clear priorities and disciplined execution help teams deliver reliable operations and better serve customers.

**Qualifications**

* Demonstrated experience in operations management, business management, strategic management, and operational management.
* Experience in senior leadership, executive leadership, executive-level team management, management, and supervising experience.
* Strong budget management, financial management, forecasting, and profit and loss analysis skills.
* Proven ability to lead process improvement, project management, business development, and organizational change.
* Excellent verbal communication with executives and a record of data-driven decision making and strategic planning.

Pay: $45.00 - $95.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Flexible schedule
* Parental leave
* Retirement plan
* Tuition reimbursement

Work Location: Hybrid remote in North Chicago, IL 60064

new_roles.title: Director of Operations - Prime Line | Bilingual (English/Spanish)
new_roles.description:
ARE YOU A CURRENT US FOODS EMPLOYEE? PLEASE APPLY DIRECTLY THROUGH OUR INTERNAL WORKDAY CAREER SITE

Join Our Community of Food People!

Job Profile Summary 
The Director, Operations - Prime Line is responsible for the overall operational performance of the Prime Line distribution network, providing strategic leadership and direction to deliver best-in-class service, safety, quality, productivity, and financial results. This role drives operational excellence across all locations, develops high-performing leadership teams, drives accountability and partners cross-functionally to execute business strategies that support growth, customer satisfaction, and long-term organizational success.

**Bilingual Requirement: Fluency in both English & Spanish is required for this position. The successful candidate must be able to effectively communicate in both languages in a professional setting to lead, develop, and support diverse teams.**

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Strategic Leadership & Operational Excellence**

* Provides strategic leadership for all Prime Line locations, establishing operational priorities and driving execution against safety, service, productivity, quality and financial objectives.

* Owns operational and financial performance across all Prime Line locations, optimizing labor, distribution, inventory flow, service levels, and operating costs to achieve business objectives and profitability targets.
* Collaborates cross-functionally to align operations with enterprise goals.
* Oversees turnaround strategies for underperforming locations and drives a culture of continuous improvement.
* Develops and executes network strategies that support growth, operational scalability, and long-term business performance.

**Talent Development & Team Leadership**

* Hires, manages, and develops high-performing Operations teams across Prime Line locations.
* Builds a high-performing leadership culture through talent development, succession planning, performance management, and leadership capability enhancement.
* Coaches and mentors leaders to promote accountability; acts quickly when performance does not meet expectations.
* Conducts performance reviews and supports succession planning and career development**.**

**Customer Experience and Operational Partnership**

* Champions initiatives that enhance customer experience through operational excellence.
* Leverages Operations Excellence insights and feedback to drive innovation in service delivery.
* Aligns operational strategies with evolving customer and Prime Line Supply Chain expectations.

* Leads initiatives that improve customer service performance, delivery execution, and overall customer satisfaction.
* Partners closely with Sales, Supply Chain, Merchandising, and Customer Service teams to ensure operational strategies align with customer expectations and business priorities.

**Accountability & Engagement**

* Ensures compliance with all regulatory requirements, company policies, food safety standards, and workplace safety expectations.
* Leads business reviews, presents performance insights to executive leadership, and develops action plans to address risks and opportunities.
* Drives associate engagement through effective leadership, recognition, and communication, fostering a culture of accountability, transparency and operational integrity.
* Leads organizational change initiatives and operational transformations to support business growth and evolving customer needs.

 

* Other duties as assigned by manager.

**SUPERVISION**:

* Directly supervises operations leadership at all Prime Line locations.

**RELATIONSHIPS:**

* **Internal**: Prime Line Leadership Team, Mergers and Acquisitions Integration Team, Field Operations, Supply Chain Planning & Replenishment, Region and Area Presidents; Area, Region and HR business partners; Program Office change resources and other Operations, Program Office, Commercial Center of Excellence and Supply Chain leaders.
* **External:** Customers, vendors, third parties and external consultants as needed.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**:

* **Onsite:** The associate in this role is expected to perform assigned responsibilities in a Prime Line office-based environment.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:**

* 10 years of progressive leadership experience in supply chain operations, including leading warehouse and/or transportation operations.
* 7 years of people leadership experience with demonstrated success leading and developing operations leaders.
* Proven track record of success in P&L ownership, strategic planning, and operational execution.
* Demonstrated success delivering results across key operational metrics, including safety, quality, productivity, and employee retention.
* Demonstrated ability to lead through organizational complexity and influence outcomes across functions and locations.
* Strong understanding of business strategy, operating models, capacity planning, and financial principles.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and translate insights into actionable business strategies.
* Strong executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to build credibility and influence senior leaders and cross-functional partners.
* Demonstrated ability to lead geographically dispersed teams and successfully develop leaders.
* Demonstrated ability to foster cross-functional collaboration and drive alignment across a matrixed organization.
* Up to 75% travel.

**EDUCATION**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Operations Management, Supply Chain Management or other relevant field or equivalent work experience.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience leading multiple geographically dispersed sites.
* Experience in foodservice, distribution, logistics, or a similarly complex operating environment.
Advanced degree. 

 

This role may also receive annual incentive plan bonus and long-term incentive program.

Benefits for this role may include health insurance, pre-tax spending accounts, retirement benefits, paid time off, short-term and long-term disability, employee stock purchase plan, and life insurance. To review available benefits, please click here: https://www.usfoods.com/careers/benefits.html.

Compensation depends on relevant experience and/or education, specific skills, function, geographic location, and other factors as applicable by law (for example: state or local minimum wage thresholds). The expected base rate for this role is between

$115,000 - $175,000

The Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced, results-driven Multi-Unit General Manager to oversee two established, high-volume independent restaurants in the Berkshires. This is a senior leadership role for someone who thrives on building strong teams, driving profitability, implementing systems, and creating operational excellence.

The ideal candidate is equal parts operator, coach, and business strategist. You'll work directly with ownership to improve performance across both locations while ensuring exceptional guest experiences and a strong workplace culture.

Key Objectives

Success in this role will be measured by:

* Growing top-line revenue
* Increasing restaurant profitability
* Reducing controllable costs
* Implementing scalable systems and procedures
* Developing and retaining high-performing managers
* Improving accountability and operational consistency
* Strengthening guest satisfaction and online reputation

ResponsibilitiesBusiness Performance

* Own P&L performance for both restaurants
* Analyze financial results and identify opportunities for revenue growth and margin improvement
* Develop and execute plans to increase sales, traffic, and guest frequency
* Monitor labor, food, beverage, and operating costs
* Establish measurable KPIs and hold management teams accountable

Leadership & Team Development

* Recruit, hire, train, and develop management staff as needed
* Create a culture of accountability, professionalism, and hospitality
* Conduct regular performance reviews and coaching sessions
* Build leadership depth within both organizations
* Resolve employee issues quickly and professionally

Operations

* Ensure consistent execution of service, food quality, and hospitality standards
* Standardize systems and procedures across both locations where appropriate
* Oversee scheduling, staffing levels, inventory controls, and purchasing
* Improve efficiency and eliminate operational bottlenecks
* Maintain compliance with all health, safety, labor, and licensing requirements

Revenue Growth

* Partner with ownership on marketing and promotional initiatives
* Identify opportunities to increase guest counts, check averages, and repeat business
* Oversee private events, catering opportunities, and community partnerships
* Evaluate menu performance and pricing strategies alongside culinary leadership

Qualifications

* 5+ years of senior restaurant management experience
* Multi-unit management experience strongly preferred
* Demonstrated success improving restaurant profitability
* Strong financial acumen with deep understanding of P&L management
* Experience managing managers and building leadership teams
* Proven ability to create systems, processes, and accountability structures
* Strong communication and organizational skills
* Hospitality-first mindset combined with strong business discipline

Ideal Candidate

You are:

* Highly accountable and results-oriented
* Comfortable making difficult decisions
* Analytical and data-driven
* Skilled at motivating teams and developing leaders
* Focused on continuous improvement
* Equally comfortable in the dining room, the kitchen, and the financial statements

What We Offer

* Competitive compensation package of $130,000–$160,000 annually
* Significant performance-based bonus opportunity
* High level of autonomy and decision-making authority
* Opportunity to make a meaningful impact on two well-established restaurants
* Direct partnership with ownership on strategy and growth initiatives

To Apply

Please submit your resume along with a brief note outlining:

* Your multi-unit management experience
* A specific example of improving profitability at a restaurant operation
* Why this opportunity interests you

Pay: $130,000.00 - $160,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

new_roles.title: Director of Operations
new_roles.description:
**Ask yourself:**

* On a scale of 1 to 10, is your work ethic a 10+?
* Do you have true GRIT, tenacity, and live in the realm where anything is possible?
* Do you solve problems creatively and yet with regard to high quality and details?
* Do you relate to people well and think on your feet?
* Do you agree with the following statement: "If it is to be, it's up to me" - if you don't agree with this quote, we are not a match.

**The above is who we are looking for! We need a LEADER who GETS THINGS DONE WITH EXCELLENCE and has a strong desire to help make a successful small business better.**

The Director of Operations (DOO) is a key Protector for the growing expansion of the business. This manager is the master of systems, consistently seeking new, innovative, and efficient business processes that save time and money. As a key leader in this company, the Director of Operations (DOO) increases the ability of the Hub to process transactions, freeing the Sales Team to focus more on generating transactions than closing them.

This person relishes the opportunity to build, implement, and manage multiple systems, and is seen throughout the organization as the expert on efficiency and systems. This person exhibits a drive to use systems as a strategic tool for creating an advantage for the organization. This individual will have some ability to show patience in finding a solution, though accomplishing the objective is more important for this person than using one specific process. This person excels at bringing a vision or an idea to life as an integrator and implementer.

The Director of Operations (DOO) is deeply committed to supporting the growth of the agents and in achieving greater and greater levels of success, and to growing his/her own skills and developing into a supportive leader/manager within the organization. As the success of the business grows, this individual will be responsible for hiring, training, and leading additional department members to ensure all administrative tasks of the lead agent’s business continue to be completed to high standards with maximum efficiency. They will also be responsible for leading the sales department from a systems/accountability position.

**Compensation:**

* Base salary $65,000 - $75,000
* Earning potential up to $90,000 - $100,000
* Bonus potential
* Growth opportunity

 **Compensation:**

$65,000 - $75,000 yearly

 **Responsibilities:**

* Lead the development and implementation of efficient business systems to enhance operational productivity.
* Collaborate with the sales team to streamline processes, allowing them to focus on generating transactions.
* Oversee the hiring, training, and leadership of new team members to maintain high standards of administrative excellence.
* Act as the primary point of contact for system-related inquiries, ensuring swift and effective resolutions.
* Continuously evaluate and refine operational strategies to align with the company's growth objectives.
* Foster a culture of innovation by encouraging team members to propose and implement process improvements.
* Monitor key performance indicators to assess the effectiveness of operational strategies and make data-driven decisions.

 
**Qualifications:**

* Experience in managing and optimizing business operations, ensuring efficiency and effectiveness in all processes.
* Proven track record of developing and implementing systems that enhance productivity and streamline workflows.
* Ability to lead and mentor teams, fostering a collaborative and accountable work environment.
* Strong financial acumen with experience in budgeting, financial reporting, and ROI tracking.
* Excellent communication skills, capable of maintaining clear and effective internal and client communications.
* Experience in overseeing marketing processes and procedures, ensuring alignment with company goals.
* Ability to create and maintain comprehensive operations manuals, documenting systems and standards in writing and video formats.

 
**About Company**

**We have built our business on sitting down with people who have an interest in owning a home, listening to their goals, and creating a specific plan to make that plan come to life.**

We love helping buyers find their dream home! That's why we work with each client individually, taking the time to understand their unique lifestyles, needs, and wishes. You'll find that we'll be a committed ally to negotiate on your behalf and with the backing of a trusted company.

identity_held_roles.title: Director Quality & Compliance
identity_held_roles.description:
**Job Description:**

**Who We Are:**

At Cart.com, we're **defining the future of commerce.**

Founded to solve the growing complexity of modern commerce, Cart.com helps businesses simplify how they sell, fulfill, and deliver products to their customers. We bring together technology, services, and logistics infrastructure into one connected platform, making it easier for organizations to grow, operate efficiently, and navigate an increasingly fragmented commerce landscape.

We work with brands, retailers, manufacturers, and public sector organizations to support every stage of the customer journey, from ecommerce and order management to fulfillment, distribution, and delivery. By combining software, expertise, and a nationwide logistics network into a unified solution, we help our customers move faster, operate smarter, and scale with confidence.

But what truly sets Cart.com apart is our people. We're builders, problem-solvers, and innovators who thrive on turning big challenges into meaningful outcomes for our customers. Every day, we're helping shape the future of commerce while creating opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact.

If you're energized by solving complex problems, collaborating with talented teammates, and helping build what's next, we'd love to hear from you.

**Cart.com Milestones**

* Founded in 2020 with a vision to build the first truly unified commerce platform.
* Achieved unicorn status with a valuation exceeding $1 billion.
* Raised more than $475 million to support continued growth and innovation
* Expanded a nationwide commerce and logistics network that helps organizations scale, fulfill, and grow across channels.
* Recognized by Inc.'s Power Partner Awards for helping businesses grow and scale.
* Recognized as an award-winning employer for four consecutive years, reflecting our commitment to building an environment where talented people can grow, innovate, and make an impact.

**Our values:** Cart.com is building a company that is committed to living out these 6 core values:

* **Be brand obsessed:** Our lives are shaped by the brands we interact with daily. We obsess over the brands we serve, and about the things they care about.
* **Think beyond the box:** “We’ve always done it that way” is not a phrase uttered often at our office. We create creative solutions to complex problems.

* **Don’t give up:** We learn from our challenges and see them for what they are; great building blocks to an amazing brand story.
* **Speak up:** We communicate clearly and directly because we care deeply. Communication is the bedrock of our community.
* **Work together:** We’ve built a team that prides itself on diversity of thought and background. Collaboration is better with contrast.
* **Remember to be human:** We work hard, but we leave room for the people, places and things that we love

**AI is part of how we work. It's not doing the hiring.** 
 
We'll use AI in parts of our process and we think you should feel free to use it too — for research, prep, whatever helps. But our interviews exist to meet *you*, not your best AI-assisted draft. Real people make every call here. Any questions about how this works, just ask.

**Remote:**

This position is fully remote and open to candidates in AZ, CA, CO, CT, DC, DE, FL, GA, HI, IL, IN, KY, LA, MA, MD, MI, MO, MS, NC, NJ, NY, NC, OH, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, WA. The salary range for this role is $175,000-200,000 annually. Actual compensation may vary based on geographic location, experience and qualifications. This role is eligible for bonus, equity and benefits including medical, dental, vision, 401(k), paid time off. Applications accepted through 1-31-2027. We comply with all applicable pay transparency laws in the states where we operate.

**The Role:**

The Director, Quality and Compliance leads the quality function for Cart.com’s federal pharmaceutical distribution business across four sites. This leader will standardize and strengthen an established quality program, develop site quality leaders, ensure consistent application of procedures, and serve as the primary quality point of contact for client reporting, audits and product-quality events.

This is approximately a 70% strategic leadership and 30% hands-on role. The Director will not build the program from the ground up, but will assess the current-state program, make targeted improvements, and ensure teams consistently execute against client, regulatory and network requirements. The role is remote with approximately 30% travel.

The role offers the opportunity to influence the quality standard for a growing federal business and help prepare the organization to support additional federal programs over time.

**What You’ll Do**

* Lead and develop site quality leaders across Maryland, Goodyear, Temecula and Memphis, establishing clear accountability, delegation and follow-through.
* Standardize quality procedures and expectations across the network while refining the existing quality management system and closing identified gaps.
* Ensure sites remain prepared for client and regulatory audits; support audit planning, host or coordinate inspections, and oversee timely responses and corrective actions.
* Serve as the primary quality point of contact for pharmaceutical product excursions and related client reporting, ensuring submissions are accurate, complete and timely.
* Oversee quality processes supporting receiving, quarantine, release, disposition, returns, destruction, recalls, deviations, corrective and preventive actions, change control, training, complaints and document control.
* Guide quality decisions for controlled-temperature pharmaceutical products, including refrigerated, frozen and ultra-cold storage and distribution.
* Partner with site Operations leaders and Cart.com’s Compliance team to implement operational changes required to meet quality standards and client expectations.
* Use quality metrics, audit findings, client feedback and site observations to identify risk, prioritize improvements and report progress to senior leadership.
* Travel to sites for audit preparation, team development, quality reviews and issue resolution.

**Who You Are:**

 

* You are a strategic, hands-on quality leader who can set direction while stepping into audits, excursions and site-readiness work when needed.
* You lead through others, delegate clearly, establish checkpoints and hold site quality leaders accountable for follow-through.
* You put the client’s requirements first, ask the right questions and respond with accurate, timely information.
* You communicate with credibility and composure across clients, regulators, Operations, Compliance and senior leadership.
* You are highly organized and disciplined, ensuring commitments, documentation and escalations do not get lost.
* You build strong cross-functional partnerships and can influence operational changes without creating a separate quality silo.
* You adapt to changing federal-client requirements while maintaining consistent quality standards and sound judgment.
* You develop people, address performance gaps directly and create a culture of ownership across a distributed team.

**What You’ve Done:**

 

* 7+ years of progressive pharmaceutical quality experience, including work in a current Good Manufacturing Practice (cGMP) facility and meaningful pharmaceutical distribution, logistics or 3PL quality exposure.
* 5+ years of people-leadership experience with demonstrated success delegating, developing leaders and holding teams accountable.
* Worked in pharmaceutical distribution, wholesale, logistics or third-party logistics (3PL). Manufacturing experience alone is not sufficient without meaningful distribution-quality exposure.
* Applied cGMP, Good Distribution Practice (GDP), controlled-document and standard operating procedure requirements in a regulated pharmaceutical environment.
* Prepared for or led audits involving the U.S. Food and Drug Administration or comparable regulators, including managing responses and follow-up actions.
* Supported pharmaceutical product release, disposition, holds, recalls or temperature-excursion decisions in a regulated distribution setting.
* Written, revised or implemented quality procedures and documentation, then ensured consistent execution across teams or sites.
* Led a distributed or multi-site team and built accountability through site leaders rather than personally owning every task.
* Managed a significant client, product-quality or regulatory issue requiring coordination across Quality, Operations and Compliance.
* Earned a bachelor’s degree in life sciences, pharmacy, biology, chemistry or a related field, or bring an equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.
* Ability to travel up to 30%.

* Background supporting federal health programs or agencies such as HHS, DLA, ASPR, BARDA, DoD or VA.
* Experience with pharmaceutical 3PLs, wholesalers, state licensing or NABP accreditation.
* Hands-on experience with vaccines or other cold-chain and ultra-cold pharmaceutical products.
* Knowledge of Drug Supply Chain Security Act requirements and suspect or illegitimate product processes.
* Relevant certifications such as ASQ Certified Quality Auditor, Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence, Certified Pharmaceutical GMP Professional or Lead Auditor.
* Master’s degree in a life-sciences or related discipline.
Direct leadership of quality teams 

 
 

**Physical Demands & Working Conditions:**

 

* Remote work environment with regular computer and video-conference use.
* Ability to travel by air or ground up to 30% and work onsite in warehouse, pharmaceutical distribution and temperature-controlled environments.
* Ability to move through operating areas and wear required personal protective equipment when visiting sites.
* Flexibility to support audits, client needs or quality events outside standard business hours when required.

identity_held_roles.title: IT Director of Quality Assurance
identity_held_roles.description:
**ABOUT ETHOS & THE OPPORTUNITY**

Ethos Risk Services is a leading insurance claims investigation and medical management company focused on delivering better data, technology, and insights that help our clients make better decisions. We are continuing to invest in our technology organization and are seeking an experienced engineering leader to help scale how software is built, tested, and delivered.

We are seeking a **full-time Director of Quality Assurance** to own software quality across Ethos, overseeing an outsourced QA team and the processes, tooling, environments, and metrics that prevent defects from reaching production. Our ideal candidate is an experienced, results-driven QA leader who will establish a consistent defect lifecycle, reduce defect aging, implement effective root cause analysis and preventive measures, and improve the reliability of test environments. Within their first year, they will standardize QA tools and processes, integrate AI-based solutions into daily QA operations and performance tracking, and establish a comprehensive KPI framework that drives measurable improvements in software quality, efficiency, and accountability.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Lead Outsourced QA Operations:** Direct the day-to-day activities of an outsourced QA team of 8 to10 resources, establishing priorities, performance expectations, and accountability for quality deliverables.
* **Manage Vendor Performance:** Oversee vendor agreements, SLAs, staffing, onboarding, and performance evaluations. Address performance gaps through corrective action and ensure effective knowledge transfer and documentation.
* **Drive Defect Management:** Establish and enforce standardized defect tracking, classification, prioritization, and resolution processes. Lead regular defect triage with engineering and product teams to manage backlogs and identify quality risks.
* **Prevent Production Issues:** Lead structured root cause analysis of production defects, identify recurring failure patterns, and implement preventive measures through improved test coverage, regression testing, and quality gates.
* **Oversee Test Environments:** Partner with DevOps to maintain stable, production-representative QA, staging, and UAT environments, including configuration standards, test data management, and environment availability.
* **Define QA Strategy & Standards:** Develop and continuously improve QA processes across manual, automated, regression, integration, performance, and user acceptance testing to strengthen quality and consistency.
* **Advance Test Automation:** Evaluate and implement QA tools and automation frameworks, integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines to improve testing efficiency, coverage, and release reliability.
* **Leverage AI-Enabled QA Tools:** Apply AI-based solutions to test generation, defect classification, failure analysis, workload management, and performance monitoring. Evaluate emerging tools and implement solutions that deliver measurable improvements while maintaining appropriate security and accuracy controls.
* **Establish Quality KPIs:** Define and monitor performance metrics, including defect escape rates, resolution times, automation coverage, recurring production incidents, test effectiveness, and vendor SLA adherence.
* **Deliver Executive Reporting:** Produce monthly quality reports and quarterly reviews for the VP of Engineering and CTO, translating performance data into actionable insights, risks, trends, and recommendations.
* **Support Release Readiness:** Collaborate with engineering, DevOps, IT Delivery Leads, and Technical Product Owners to integrate QA into sprint and release planning, assess release quality, and recommend readiness for deployment.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

**Education:** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience (required).

**Required Experience:**

* 8 to 10 years of progressively greater responsibility in software quality assurance.
* 3 to 4 years in a QA management role leading teams and managers.
* Proven expertise in defect lifecycle management, root cause analysis, and preventive quality practices.
* Hands-on experience establishing and maintaining test environments and test data management practices.
* Strong working knowledge of QA tooling, such as test management (e.g., Xray, Zephyr, TestRail), defect tracking (e.g., Jira, Azure DevOps), and automation frameworks (e.g., Selenium, Playwright, Cypress).
* Practical experience using AI-based tools in QA or team management, and enthusiasm for expanding their use.
* Experience defining QA KPIs and producing executive-level monthly and quarterly reporting.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated testing into delivery workflows.

**Preferred Experience:**

* Performance, security, or API testing, and a regulated-industry background.
* Certifications: ISTQB Advanced or Test Manager, CSQE, or similar.
* Experience with data visualization or dashboard tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau)

**WORKING AT ETHOS**

This is a 100% remote U.S.-based role, offering the flexibility to work from home while remaining closely connected to a collaborative leadership team. Our ideal candidate is available during EST standard business hours. Occasional travel may be required for quarterly or annual leadership meetings and company events.

**Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States and must not require current or future employment sponsorship.**

**Benefits include:** Paid Time Off and Sick Time **|** Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance **|** Short-Term + Long-Term Disability Insurance + Life Insurance **|** 401(k) Matching **|** Employee Referral Bonus Program

At Ethos, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact, shape the future of our engineering organization, and help build the systems and processes that support our next stage of growth. **To learn more about Ethos, visit our website:** https://ethosrisk.com/about-us/

*Ethos Risk Services is an equal opportunity employer and considers qualified applicants without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable law.*

identity_held_roles.title: VP of Production
identity_held_roles.description:
**VP of Production**
--------------------

**Location:** Los Angeles, Detroit, or San Francisco 
**Employment:** Full time, in person 
**Base salary:** $200,000–$350,000 annually

American factories deserve a supply chain that moves as fast as they do. Nox Metals is building it, along with the tools that run it. We’re a technology company supplying raw metal to frontier American manufacturers. We use software and automation to supply metal to factories faster than the industry thought possible.

### **The role**

We’re hiring a VP of Production to lead manufacturing performance across Nox Metals’ facilities. You will own how work moves through our factories: production planning, daily execution, capacity, staffing, quality, productivity, and on-time delivery.

This is a hands-on manufacturing leadership role with real time on the factory floor. You will develop production leaders, resolve constraints, and create repeatable ways of working that help teams deliver as demand grows. Success means safe, reliable production and clear accountability from the daily schedule through completed customer orders.

### **You will**

* Lead production execution across facilities, with clear expectations for safety, quality, output, cost, and delivery.
* Translate demand into practical production, staffing, shift, and capacity plans.
* Develop plant and production leaders who take ownership of results and build strong teams.
* Establish daily operating reviews, shift handoffs, escalation paths, and performance measures that drive action.
* Identify bottlenecks, reduce downtime and rework, and improve material flow and labor productivity.
* Build consistent training, work instructions, and qualification standards while staying close to how work happens.
* Protect material traceability and quality throughout production.
* Partner with maintenance and engineering on equipment reliability, capacity improvements, and automation.
* Work with supply chain and commercial teams to align material availability, production commitments, and customer needs.
* Partner with finance on production economics and equipment investment decisions.
* Help new or expanded facilities establish reliable production and sustain performance as they ramp.

### **You are**

* A manufacturing leader with a record of improving factory performance and developing accountable leaders.
* Experienced managing production teams, schedules, equipment constraints, and competing priorities.
* Uncompromising about safety, quality, and traceability.
* Fluent in capacity, throughput, labor productivity, downtime, and delivery performance.
* Comfortable making decisions on the floor and following through until problems are resolved.
* Practical, direct, and interested in improving manufacturing with software and automation.

### **Nice to have**

Experience leading multiple facilities, scaling production through rapid growth, or working in metals, machining, aerospace, industrial distribution, or related environments.

Expect regular time at our manufacturing facilities and travel between sites as needed.

Nox Metals is an equal opportunity employer. We hire based on skill, attitude, and fit for the work, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, height, weight, marital status, or any other protected status under federal, state, or local law.

We will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in a manner consistent with the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, and the California Fair Chance Act.

Compensation Range: $200K - $350K

identity_held_roles.description:
**Description**

Sanmina Corporation (Nasdaq: SANM) is a global powerhouse in integrated manufacturing solutions serving the fastest growing segments of the global Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS) market. We are a global engine providing the end-to-end manufacturing backbone for the world's most essential and innovative brands. Whether it's autonomous vehicles, life-saving medical tech, next-gen aerospace, or AI/cloud infrastructure - our integrated solutions don’t just meet standards—they redefine them.Sanmina Corporation (Nasdaq: SANM) is a leading integrated manufacturing solutions provider serving the fastest-growing segments of the global Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS) market. Job Purpose:As Quality Director the role will be responsible for developing a world class quality culture and drive region wide continuous improvement projects that result in unparalleled quality performance. You will have the opportunity to reinforce foundational quality principles, as we develop innovative manufacturing, test, inspection and automation processes to build high quality semiconductor, defense and data infrastructure products. This position will be responsible for managing, coordinating and administering all functions of the region’s Quality Management System.What You'll DoLead and mentor QA organizations.Be an outspoken advocate for Quality First throughout the regionExpediently and effectively communicate with customers on quality escapes, visits, escalations, etc.Help maintain and improve the site QMS (including NCR and CAPA system, internal audit, training, etc.)Responsible for ensuring effective quality planning (including PFMEAs, process flows and control plans) for NPI and production parts.Help maintain the site QMS compliance with ISO 9001:2015 and TL9000, ISO 13485, FDA registration and any other regulatory compliance in line with the factory center of excellence Act as advisory to developing additional sources of data and tracking and reporting key Quality-related performance indicators (KPIs), including first pass yield, scrap rates and statistical process control.Oversight of managing and improving site supplier qualityBe an advocate for lean and six sigma manufacturing principles and drive continuous improvementDrive cross functional projects with manufacturing, supply chain, and engineering to verify and validate existing manufacturing processes and capabilitiesCoordinate development of Quality Plan and participate in Design for Manufacturability (DFM) reviews for new customer on-boardingAddress process yields by driving cross-functional teams to develop and implement corrective actions utilizing a methodical approach (DMAIC) to root cause and continuous improvement. What You'll BringBachelor’s Degree required, Mechanical, Aerospace, Industrial or Mfg Engineering preferred10+ years of Quality Engineering or Management experience in a regulated manufacturing environment. Printed circuit board experience is a plus but not required5+ years of direct people managementKnowledge of IPC-6012 and IPC-A-600 desiredDemonstrated experience working directly with customers to resolve concerns, conduct audits and host visitsUnderstanding of ISO 9001:2015, AS9100, TL-9000, ISO-14385, ISO-14001, MIL-PRF-31032 or similar standards with demonstrated success in passing certification auditsExpert level knowledge of root cause analysis techniques and corrective actionHands on experience working with suppliers to improve qualityKnowledge of lean principles (Green or Black belt certification a plus)Knowledge and experience in the application of statistical process controlDemonstrated experience leading diverse teams in a dynamic environment requiredExcellent written and verbal communication and presentation skills requiredOpen-minded self-starter with the ability to adapt, improvise and problem solve, as well manage multiple tasks and projects and concisely explain complex issues supported with data.Excellent analytical abilities and comprehensive understanding of quality toolbox (SPC, 8D, FMEA, Control Plans, etc.) Salary Range (annual): $140,000 - $165,000 Why Join Us?At Sanmina, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $xx and $xx, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.Sanmina employees also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Sanmina, reimbursement for certain educational expenses — including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation.Sanmina is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment. Sanmina provides equal employment opportunities to employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.Please be aware that this position may require access to technology, software, or technical data that is subject to U.S. export control laws. All offers of employment are contingent on the applicant either 1) being a "U.S. Person," defined as a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful permanent resident, or (iii) other protected individual, such as a refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157 or asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158; or 2) being eligible to obtain a timely export control license or license exception from the applicable U.S. federal agency.
